27.2.323.s: yadi purā prajājebhyo bahiḥparidhy aṅgārā abhiparyāvarteran brāhmaṇoktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kṛtvā | imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi | ity etayā sruvāhutiṃ juhuyāt
27.2.323.d: यदि पुरा प्रजाजेभ्यो बहिःपरिध्य् अङ्गारा अभिपर्यावर्तेरन् ब्राह्मणोक्तं प्रायश्चित्तं कृत्वा । इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि । इत्य् एतया स्रुवाहुतिं जुहुयात्
27.2.323.m: If before the prājājas [an error occurs], or if coals roll out beyond the enclosing sticks, having performed the expiation stated in the brāhmaṇa passage, he should offer a ladle libation with [the verse]: "I place this enclosing stick for the living..."

27.2.323.s: sarvatra vitate yajñakarmaṇi yadi yajñabhreṣa āgacchet | iṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā vaṣaḍ aniṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā | ity etair aṣṭābhiḥ sruvāhutīr juhuyāt
27.2.323.d: सर्वत्र वितते यज्ञकर्मणि यदि यज्ञभ्रेष आगच्छेत् । इष्टेभ्यः स्वाहा वषड् अनिष्टेभ्यः स्वाहा । इत्य् एतैर् अष्टाभिः स्रुवाहुतीर् जुहुयात्
27.2.323.m: Everywhere in the spread sacrifice, if a slip in the sacrifice should occur, he should offer ladle libations with these eight [formulas]: "To what is offered, svāhā! Vaṣaṭ! To what is unoffered, svāhā!"

27.2.323.s: sarvatra vitate yajñakarmaṇi yadi janyaṃ bhayam āgacchet | yata indra bhayāmahe svastidā viśaspatis | ity etābhyām̐ sruvāhutī juhuyād abhaye vā punar yajeta
27.2.323.d: सर्वत्र वितते यज्ञकर्मणि यदि जन्यं भयम् आगच्छेत् । यत इन्द्र भयामहे स्वस्तिदा विशस्पतिस् । इत्य् एताभ्याँ स्रुवाहुती जुहुयाद् अभये वा पुनर् यजेत
27.2.323.m: Everywhere in the spread sacrifice, if danger from people should approach, he should offer two ladle libations with [the two verses]: "Whereof we are afraid, O Indra..." and "The granter of well-being, the lord of clans...", or he should sacrifice again when safety is restored.

27.2.324.s: sarvatropām̐śuprabhṛti vāca sthānānām̐ svarākṣarapadavṛttabhreṣeṣu | ābhir gīrbhir yad ato na ūnam ity etayā sruvāhutiṃ juhuyāt
27.2.324.d: सर्वत्रोपाँशुप्रभृति वाच स्थानानाँ स्वराक्षरपदवृत्तभ्रेषेषु । आभिर् गीर्भिर् यद् अतो न ऊनम् इत्य् एतया स्रुवाहुतिं जुहुयात्
27.2.324.m: Everywhere, in slips of tone, syllables, words, or meter from among the places of speech beginning with the silent, he should offer a ladle libation with: "With these songs, what of ours was deficient..."

27.2.324.s: sarvatrānājñātaprāyaścitteṣu | anājñātam | puruṣasaṃmitas | ity etābhyām̐ sruvāhutī juhuyāt
27.2.324.d: सर्वत्रानाज्ञातप्रायश्चित्तेषु । अनाज्ञातम् । पुरुषसंमितस् । इत्य् एताभ्याँ स्रुवाहुती जुहुयात्
27.2.324.m: Everywhere, in expiations for the unknown, he should offer two ladle libations with: "Unknown..." and "Measured to a man..."

27.2.324.s: sarvatredhmābarhiṣaḥ prayājānūyājānāṃ pākatrākarmasu yat pākatrā manasā | ity etayā sruvāhutiṃ juhuyāt
27.2.324.d: सर्वत्रेध्माबर्हिषः प्रयाजानूयाजानां पाकत्राकर्मसु यत् पाकत्रा मनसा । इत्य् एतया स्रुवाहुतिं जुहुयात्
27.2.324.m: Everywhere, in actions performed in ignorance concerning the kindling wood and sacrificial grass, or the fore-offerings and after-offerings, he should offer a ladle libation with: "What with simple mind..."

27.2.324.s: sarvatra skanne bhinne chinne bhagne naṣṭe kṣāme viparyāsa uddāha ūnātirikte vā yan ma ātmano mindābhūt punar agniś cakṣur adāt | ity etābhyām̐ sruvāhutī juhuyāt sarveṣv agnyupaghāteṣu punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatām ity etayā samidham ādadhyād etayaiva sruvāhutiṃ juhuyāt sarveṣu yajñakratuṣu patnīḥ saṃyājya prāṅ etya dhruvām āpyāyya dhruvātaḥ sarvaprāyaścittāni juhoti brahma pratiṣṭhā manasas | ity etenānuvākena praty ṛcam
27.2.324.d: सर्वत्र स्कन्ने भिन्ने छिन्ने भग्ने नष्टे क्षामे विपर्यास उद्दाह ऊनातिरिक्ते वा यन् म आत्मनो मिन्दाभूत् पुनर् अग्निश् चक्षुर् अदात् । इत्य् एताभ्याँ स्रुवाहुती जुहुयात् सर्वेष्व् अग्न्युपघातेषु पुनस् त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः समिन्धताम् इत्य् एतया समिधम् आदध्याद् एतयैव स्रुवाहुतिं जुहुयात् सर्वेषु यज्ञक्रतुषु पत्नीः संयाज्य प्राङ् एत्य ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य ध्रुवातः सर्वप्रायश्चित्तानि जुहोति ब्रह्म प्रतिष्ठा मनसस् । इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन प्रत्य् ऋचम्
27.2.324.m: Everywhere, when [an object is] spilled, broken, cut, fractured, lost, burnt, transposed, scorched, deficient, or excessive, he should offer two ladle libations with: "Whatever injury has occurred to my own self..." and "Fire has given back sight..."; in all contaminations of the fire, he should put on a kindling stick with: "May the Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus kindle thee again!" and with that very [verse] he should offer a ladle libation; in all sacrificial rites, after making the wife-offerings and going east, having swelled the dhruvā ladle, he offers all the expiations from the dhruvā with the anuvāka beginning with: "Brahman is the support of the mind...", verse by verse.

27.2.324.s: samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti yajñasya samiṣṭyai yad vai yajñasya krūraṃ yad viliṣṭaṃ yad atyeti yan nātyeti yad atikaroti yan nāpikaroti tad eva taiḥ prīṇāti | iti brāhmaṇam
27.2.324.d: समिष्टयजूँषि जुहोति यज्ञस्य समिष्ट्यै यद् वै यज्ञस्य क्रूरं यद् विलिष्टं यद् अत्येति यन् नात्येति यद् अतिकरोति यन् नापिकरोति तद् एव तैः प्रीणाति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
27.2.324.m: "He offers the samiṣṭayajus formulas for the completion of the sacrifice; / whatever is raw in the sacrifice, whatever is dislocated, whatever exceeds, whatever does not exceed, whatever overdoes, whatever underdoes—that very thing he gratifies with them," so says the brāhmaṇa passage.

27.2.325.s: etāny eva brāhmaṇavidhivihitāny āpyāyanāni mantravanti bhavantīti baudhāyanas |
27.2.325.d: एतान्य् एव ब्राह्मणविधिविहितान्य् आप्यायनानि मन्त्रवन्ति भवन्तीति बौधायनस् ।
27.2.325.m: "Only these swelling rites ordained by the rule of the brāhmaṇa passage are accompanied by mantras," says Baudhāyana.
"Those recited in the collections of mantras are occasional [rites]," says Śālīki.

27.3.325.s: atha kapālakaraṇe rathacakracityākṛtyaśvaśaphamātram̐ sthānaṃ kalpitaṃ bhavati
27.3.325.d: अथ कपालकरणे रथचक्रचित्याकृत्यश्वशफमात्रँ स्थानं कल्पितं भवति
27.3.325.m: Now, at the making of the potsherds, a place is prepared of the size of a chariot wheel, an altar pile shape, or a horse's hoof.

27.3.325.s: saṃkalpo 'dhikāraḥ kapālavṛddhiḥ kapālahrāso vā kapālānām anabhiprathane vyāhṛtībhir āhavanīye sruvāhutīr juhuyāt | bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar ity etāvad eva nānāprathane cātiprathane ca |
27.3.325.d: संकल्पो ऽधिकारः कपालवृद्धिः कपालह्रासो वा कपालानाम् अनभिप्रथने व्याहृतीभिर् आहवनीये स्रुवाहुतीर् जुहुयात् । भूर् भुवः सुवर् इत्य् एतावद् एव नानाप्रथने चातिप्रथने च ।
27.3.325.m: Intention, ritual qualification, increase of potsherds, or decrease of potsherds—in the case of non-spreading of the potsherds, he should offer ladle libations into the āhavanīya fire with the vyāhṛtis: "Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ"—just so much also in the case of diverse spreading and excessive spreading.

27.3.325.s: atha haviṣām aśṛtadravadāhotsekanisrāve prāyaścittis | aśṛte rudrāya svāhā | ity āhavanīye sruvāhutiṃ juhuyād drave vāyave vidagdhe nirṛtyai
27.3.325.d: अथ हविषाम् अशृतद्रवदाहोत्सेकनिस्रावे प्रायश्चित्तिस् । अशृते रुद्राय स्वाहा । इत्य् आहवनीये स्रुवाहुतिं जुहुयाद् द्रवे वायवे विदग्धे निरृत्यै
27.3.325.m: Now, the expiation for oblations that are uncooked, liquid, burnt, spilled over, or leaked: if uncooked, he should offer a ladle libation into the āhavanīya fire with: "To Rudra, svāhā!"; if liquid, to Vāyu; if scorched, to Nirṛti.

27.3.325.s: yadi dagdham̐ syād yat tatra śṛtam̐ syāt tena pracaret | atha yadi sarvam eva dagdham̐ syād apo 'bhyavahṛtya mindāhutī juhuyāt |
27.3.325.d: यदि दग्धँ स्याद् यत् तत्र शृतँ स्यात् तेन प्रचरेत् । अथ यदि सर्वम् एव दग्धँ स्याद् अपो ऽभ्यवहृत्य मिन्दाहुती जुहुयात् ।
27.3.325.m: If it is burnt, he should proceed with whatever is properly cooked therein; now, if it is completely burnt, having consigned it to the waters, he should offer the mindā libations.

27.3.325.s: athānyaṃ nirvaped ājyena vā pracaret saiva tataḥ prāyaścittis | yasyaiyasyai diśy utsicyeta tasyaitasyai devatāyai sruvāhutiṃ juhuyād yadi prāg agnaye yadi dakṣiṇato yamāya yadi paścād varuṇāya yady uttarataḥ somāya |
27.3.325.d: अथान्यं निर्वपेद् आज्येन वा प्रचरेत् सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिस् । यस्यैयस्यै दिश्य् उत्सिच्येत तस्यैतस्यै देवतायै स्रुवाहुतिं जुहुयाद् यदि प्राग् अग्नये यदि दक्षिणतो यमाय यदि पश्चाद् वरुणाय यद्य् उत्तरतः सोमाय ।
27.3.325.m: Then he should parcel out another [oblation], or he should proceed with ghee; that itself is the expiation for it; towards whichever quarter it spills over, to that deity he should offer a ladle libation: if towards the east, to Agni; if towards the south, to Yama; if towards the west, to Varuṇa; if towards the north, to Soma.

27.3.326.s: atha yadi sarvata evotsicyetaitābhyaḥ sarvābhyo devatābhyaḥ sruvāhutīr juhuyāt
27.3.326.d: अथ यदि सर्वत एवोत्सिच्येतैताभ्यः सर्वाभ्यो देवताभ्यः स्रुवाहुतीर् जुहुयात्
27.3.326.m: Now, if it spills over on all sides, he should offer ladle libations to all these deities.

27.3.326.s: tam ājyenāpyāyanībhyām āpyāyayati | āpyāyasva saṃ te | iti |
27.3.326.d: तम् आज्येनाप्यायनीभ्याम् आप्याययति । आप्यायस्व सं ते । इति ।
27.3.326.m: He swells it with ghee with the two swelling verses: "Swell up..." and "Together with thee..."

27.3.326.s: atha haviṣām udvāsanakāle patanaphālanakhaṇḍanodvartanasam̐sarpaṇaviparītavyavāyakaraṇeṣu vyāhṛtībhir āhavanīye sruvāhutīr juhuyāt | bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar iti |
27.3.326.d: अथ हविषाम् उद्वासनकाले पतनफालनखण्डनोद्वर्तनसँसर्पणविपरीतव्यवायकरणेषु व्याहृतीभिर् आहवनीये स्रुवाहुतीर् जुहुयात् । भूर् भुवः सुवर् इति ।
27.3.326.m: Now, at the time of taking down the oblations, in cases of falling, splitting, crumbling, rolling, sliding, or making an inverted separation, he should offer ladle libations into the āhavanīya fire with the vyāhṛtis: "Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ."

27.3.326.s: athāntareṇa vedyutkarāv udaṅṅ upaniṣkramyā tamitor udaṅṅ upaniḥsṛpya vyāhṛtīr uktvā vyāhṛtībhir eva pratipadyate ||
27.3.326.d: अथान्तरेण वेद्युत्कराव् उदङ्ङ् उपनिष्क्रम्या तमितोर् उदङ्ङ् उपनिःसृप्य व्याहृतीर् उक्त्वा व्याहृतीभिर् एव प्रतिपद्यते ॥
27.3.326.m: Then, having stepped out northward between the altar and the rubbish heap, having crept out northward until exhausted, having uttered the vyāhṛtis, he proceeds with the vyāhṛtis alone.

27.4.326.s: vyāhṛtayas tu catuṣpādā navām̐śāś ca ṣaḍakṣarāḥ |
27.4.326.d: व्याहृतयस् तु चतुष्पादा नवाँशाश् च षडक्षराः ।
27.4.326.m: The vyāhṛtis have four feet, nine parts, and six syllables;
they are the beginning, middle, and end even of the four Vedas.

27.4.326.s: mantronaṃ vātiriktaṃ vā duriṣṭaṃ vāpi yad bhavet |
27.4.326.d: मन्त्रोनं वातिरिक्तं वा दुरिष्टं वापि यद् भवेत् ।
27.4.326.m: Whatever is deficient in mantra, or redundant, or ill-sacrificed,

27.4.326.s: vyapohayanti pāpmānaṃ tasmād vyāhṛtayaḥ smṛtā iti ||
27.4.326.d: व्यपोहयन्ति पाप्मानं तस्माद् व्याहृतयः स्मृता इति ॥
27.4.326.m: they dispel the evil; therefore they are remembered as the 'utterances' (vyāhṛtis).

27.4.326.s: yady ṛkto yajñabhreṣa āgacchet | bhūs | iti gārhapatye juhuyāt | yadi yajuṣṭo bhuvas | ity anvāhāryapacane
27.4.326.d: यद्य् ऋक्तो यज्ञभ्रेष आगच्छेत् । भूस् । इति गार्हपत्ये जुहुयात् । यदि यजुष्टो भुवस् । इत्य् अन्वाहार्यपचने
27.4.326.m: If a flaw in the sacrifice should occur on account of the Ṛgveda, he should offer in the gārhapatya fire with 'Bhūḥ!'; / if on account of the Yajurveda, in the anvāhāryapacana fire with 'Bhuvaḥ!';
if on account of the Sāmaveda, in the āhavanīya fire with 'Suvaḥ!';
if on account of everything, he should offer all [three].

27.4.327.s: uddhṛte tu puroḍāśe vepite syandite tathā |
27.4.327.d: उद्धृते तु पुरोडाशे वेपिते स्यन्दिते तथा ।
27.4.327.m: 'When the sacrificial cake is displaced, shaken, or has flowed,

27.4.327.s: bhinne sam̐sarpaṇe cāpi prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet | iti ||
27.4.327.d: भिन्ने सँसर्पणे चापि प्रायश्चित्तं कथं भवेत् । इति ॥
27.4.327.m: or when broken, or creeping: what would be the expiation?'—thus.

27.4.327.s: uddhṛte tu kulam̐ hanyāt | vepite naśyati prajā |
27.4.327.d: उद्धृते तु कुलँ हन्यात् । वेपिते नश्यति प्रजा ।
27.4.327.m: 'When it is displaced, it would destroy the family; when shaken, the offspring perishes;

27.4.327.s: bhinne sam̐sarpaṇe cāpi yajamānaḥ pramīyate | iti ||
27.4.327.d: भिन्ने सँसर्पणे चापि यजमानः प्रमीयते । इति ॥
27.4.327.m: and when broken, or creeping, the sacrificer dies.'

27.4.327.s: atha patanaphālanakhaṇḍanodvatanasam̐sarpaṇeṣu prasiddham udvāsya barhiṣadaṃ kṛtvā prabhūtena sarpiṣāvasicyābhimantrayate kim ut patasi kim ut proṣṭhāḥ śāntaḥ śānter ihāgahi |
27.4.327.d: अथ पतनफालनखण्डनोद्वतनसँसर्पणेषु प्रसिद्धम् उद्वास्य बर्हिषदं कृत्वा प्रभूतेन सर्पिषावसिच्याभिमन्त्रयते किम् उत् पतसि किम् उत् प्रोष्ठाः शान्तः शान्तेर् इहागहि ।
27.4.327.m: Now, in cases of falling, splitting, breaking into pieces, overturning, and creeping, having removed it in the usual manner and placed it on the sacrificial grass, having sprinkled it with abundant ghee, he consecrates it with: 'Why do you fly up? Why have you leapt? Calmed, come hither from calm!

27.4.327.s: aghoro yajñiyo bhūtvā | āsīda sadanam̐ svam āsīda sadanam̐ svam iti
27.4.327.d: अघोरो यज्ञियो भूत्वा । आसीद सदनँ स्वम् आसीद सदनँ स्वम् इति
27.4.327.m: Having become benign and worthy of sacrifice, / sit down in your own seat! Sit down in your own seat!'—thus.
Having given a choice gift to the brahman priest, he should set it down within the altar.
When that is completed, he should apportion [an offering] accompanied by the Surabhimat verses.
When that is completed, he should apportion [an offering] accompanied by the Tantumat verse.

27.4.327.s: āyuṣmatyas tu kartavyās | uttarāś chandasaḥ kriyāḥ |
27.4.327.d: आयुष्मत्यस् तु कर्तव्यास् । उत्तराश् छन्दसः क्रियाः ।
27.4.327.m: 'The subsequent rites of the meters, however, / are to be performed with [verses] containing the word āyus (life-span);

27.4.327.s: havirbhreṣavidhis tv eṣa eṣas vihitas tattvadarśibhis | iti ||
27.4.327.d: हविर्भ्रेषविधिस् त्व् एष एषस् विहितस् तत्त्वदर्शिभिस् । इति ॥
27.4.327.m: this rule for a flaw in the oblation / has been prescribed by the seers of truth.'

27.4.328.m: 'In the case of spillage, taking, or apportioning, / and the consecration of the materials,

27.4.328.s: yasmin kāle vijānīyāt tat kuryāt karmasam̐stare ||
27.4.328.d: यस्मिन् काले विजानीयात् तत् कुर्यात् कर्मसँस्तरे ॥
27.4.328.m: at whatever time he might recognise it, / he should do that in the performance of the ritual.'

27.4.328.s: praṇavo vyāhṛtayaś caiva yajña eṣa paro 'varaḥ |
27.4.328.d: प्रणवो व्याहृतयश् चैव यज्ञ एष परो ऽवरः ।
27.4.328.m: 'The syllable Om and the vyāhṛtis: / this is the higher and lower sacrifice.

27.4.328.s: tasmād yajñasya yat skannam | viparītaṃ ca yad bhavet |
27.4.328.d: तस्माद् यज्ञस्य यत् स्कन्नम् । विपरीतं च यद् भवेत् ।
27.4.328.m: Therefore, whatever of the sacrifice is spilled, / and whatever should be inverted,

27.4.328.s: tat sarvaṃ vyāhṛtībhiḥ kuryāt | anyatra ca vaṣaṭkṛtāt ||
27.4.328.d: तत् सर्वं व्याहृतीभिः कुर्यात् । अन्यत्र च वषट्कृतात् ॥
27.4.328.m: all that he should perform with the vyāhṛtis, / except after the vaṣaṭ call has been made.'

27.4.328.s: ajānadbhiḥ kṛtaṃ yac ca tvaramāṇaiś ca yat kṛtam |
27.4.328.d: अजानद्भिः कृतं यच् च त्वरमाणैश् च यत् कृतम् ।
27.4.328.m: 'And what was done by those who do not know, / and what was done by those in haste,

27.4.328.s: vyāhṛtīnāṃ prayogeṇa yat kṛtaṃ kṛtam eva tat iti |
27.4.328.d: व्याहृतीनां प्रयोगेण यत् कृतं कृतम् एव तत् इति ।
27.4.328.m: by the employment of the vyāhṛtis / whatever was done becomes truly done.'
'One should state the measurements of the potsherds / in the procedure of the adhvaryu priest:
equal, four-cornered, / two aṅgulas on all sides.'
According to the measure of the modified forms of the oblation, they enlarge them evenly or unevenly—so says Baudhāyana.

27.5.328.s: athāraṇigatānām ātmagatānām ajasrāṇām anvāhitānām̐ savanagatānāṃ cāgnīnām udvātānāṃ prāyaścittis |
27.5.328.d: अथारणिगतानाम् आत्मगतानाम् अजस्राणाम् अन्वाहितानाँ सवनगतानां चाग्नीनाम् उद्वातानां प्रायश्चित्तिस् ।
27.5.328.m: Now, the expiation for sacred fires that have entered into the churning-sticks, entered into oneself, [or are] perpetual, fueled, or belonging to the pressing, when they have gone out:

27.5.328.s: araṇigataṃ mathitvā vihāraṃ kalpayitvā gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye saṃtanīṃ juhoti mano jyotir juṣatām ājyam | vicchinnaṃ yajñam̐ sam imaṃ dadhātu |
27.5.328.d: अरणिगतं मथित्वा विहारं कल्पयित्वा गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये संतनीं जुहोति मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् आज्यम् । विच्छिन्नं यज्ञँ सम् इमं दधातु ।
27.5.328.m: Having churned that which has entered into the churning-sticks, having arranged the sacrificial area, having melted ghee on the gārhapatya fire, having purified it, and having taken four ladlings in the ladle, he offers the connecting libation (saṃtanī) in the āhavanīya fire with: 'May the Mind, the light, relish the ghee! / May it unite this severed sacrifice!

27.5.329.s: yā iṣṭā uṣaso nimrucaś ca tāḥ saṃdadhāmi haviṣā ghṛtena svāhā | iti |
27.5.329.d: या इष्टा उषसो निम्रुचश् च ताः संदधामि हविषा घृतेन स्वाहा । इति ।
27.5.329.m: The dawns and the settings that have been sacrificed, / those I unite with the oblation, with ghee, svāhā!'—thus.

27.5.329.d: एतत् प्रायश्चित्तम् अनुगते ऽहुते ऽभ्युदिते ऽभिनिम्रुक्ते च ।
27.5.329.m: This is the expiation when [the fire] has gone out, when it has not been offered, when the sun has risen over it, and when the sun has set over it.
This is [the expiation] for an elder brother passed over in marriage; / this is for a younger brother married before his elder;

27.5.329.s: etat parivividānasya | etat somavāmine somātipavitāya bhakṣāntaritasya |
27.5.329.d: एतत् परिविविदानस्य । एतत् सोमवामिने सोमातिपविताय भक्षान्तरितस्य ।
27.5.329.m: this is for one who has married before an elder brother; / this is for one who vomits soma, for one over-purified by soma, or for one excluded from the portion;

27.5.329.s: etad bhakṣarahitasya | etat parīṣṭasya | etat pariyaṣṭus | etad eva yasya puruṣo ratho 'śvo gaur mahiṣo varāho 'hir mṛgaḥ śvā vānyad vā śvāpadam antarāgnīn gacchet |
27.5.329.d: एतद् भक्षरहितस्य । एतत् परीष्टस्य । एतत् परियष्टुस् । एतद् एव यस्य पुरुषो रथो ऽश्वो गौर् महिषो वराहो ऽहिर् मृगः श्वा वान्यद् वा श्वापदम् अन्तराग्नीन् गच्छेत् ।
27.5.329.m: this is for one destitute of the portion; / this is for one passed over in sacrificing; / this is for one who sacrifices before [an elder]; / this very same [is the expiation] for one between whose fires a man, chariot, horse, cow, buffalo, boar, snake, deer, dog, or other wild beast should pass;

27.5.329.s: etad eva yasyāgner ekadeśam apahareyus | etad eva sarvāsv evāgnihotrasyārtiṣu manasvatyā prāyaścittiḥ kriyate |
27.5.329.d: एतद् एव यस्याग्नेर् एकदेशम् अपहरेयुस् । एतद् एव सर्वास्व् एवाग्निहोत्रस्यार्तिषु मनस्वत्या प्रायश्चित्तिः क्रियते ।
27.5.329.m: this very same for one from whose fire they have taken away a portion; / this very same expiation is performed with the Manasvatī verse in all afflictions of the agnihotra.
'Having sacrificed, he becomes more prosperous'—so says the brāhmaṇa passage.

27.6.329.s: atha darśapūrṇamāsayoś catvāra ṛtvijas teṣām ekasminn avidyamāne trayaḥ pracareyur dvau vā |
27.6.329.d: अथ दर्शपूर्णमासयोश् चत्वार ऋत्विजस् तेषाम् एकस्मिन्न् अविद्यमाने त्रयः प्रचरेयुर् द्वौ वा ।
27.6.329.m: Now, in the new and full moon rituals, there are four officiating priests. / In the absence of one of them, three or two may proceed.

27.6.329.s: atha yady eka eva syāt purā prayājebhya ājyasthālyāḥ sruveṇopaghātam ekādhvaryavaprāyaścittāni juhoti juṣṭo vāco bhūyāsam | juṣṭo vācaspataye devi vāk |
27.6.329.d: अथ यद्य् एक एव स्यात् पुरा प्रयाजेभ्य आज्यस्थाल्याः स्रुवेणोपघातम् एकाध्वर्यवप्रायश्चित्तानि जुहोति जुष्टो वाचो भूयासम् । जुष्टो वाचस्पतये देवि वाक् ।
27.6.329.m: Now, if there should be only one, before the fore-offerings he offers the expiations for a single adhvaryu priest by dipping [the spoon] from the ghee-pot with the sruva spoon: 'May I be agreeable to speech! / May I be agreeable to the lord of speech! O divine Speech,

27.6.329.s: yad vāco madhumat tasmin mā dhāḥ sarasvatyai svāhā ||
27.6.329.d: यद् वाचो मधुमत् तस्मिन् मा धाः सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा ॥
27.6.329.m: place me in that which is honeyed of speech! To Sarasvatī, svāhā!

27.6.330.s: imām evāśvinā yajñasya yad vāco yad duriṣṭam |
27.6.330.d: इमाम् एवाश्विना यज्ञस्य यद् वाचो यद् दुरिष्टम् ।
27.6.330.m: Whatever of this speech of the sacrifice, O Aśvins, whatever is ill-sacrificed,

27.6.330.s: tad aśvinau bheṣajena saṃdadhātām̐ svāhā || trātāram indram avitāram indram | havehave suhavam̐ śūram indram |
27.6.330.d: तद् अश्विनौ भेषजेन संदधाताँ स्वाहा ॥ त्रातारम् इन्द्रम् अवितारम् इन्द्रम् । हवेहवे सुहवँ शूरम् इन्द्रम् ।
27.6.330.m: may the Aśvins heal that with medicine, svāhā! // / Indra the protector, Indra the helper, / Indra the hero who is easily invoked at every invocation,

27.6.330.s: huve nu śakraṃ puruhūtam indram | svasti no maghavā dhātv indraḥ svāhā |
27.6.330.d: हुवे नु शक्रं पुरुहूतम् इन्द्रम् । स्वस्ति नो मघवा धात्व् इन्द्रः स्वाहा ।
27.6.330.m: now I invoke Indra the mighty, invoked by many; / may generous Indra grant us well-being, svāhā!

27.6.330.s: yan me manasaś chidraṃ yad vāco yac ca me hṛdaḥ | devās tac chamayantu sarvam̐ somo bṛhaspatiś ca svāhā ||
27.6.330.d: यन् मे मनसश् छिद्रं यद् वाचो यच् च मे हृदः । देवास् तच् छमयन्तु सर्वँ सोमो बृहस्पतिश् च स्वाहा ॥
27.6.330.m: Whatever defect there is of my mind, whatever of speech, and whatever of my heart, / may the gods appease all that, Soma and Bṛhaspati, svāhā!

27.6.330.s: yad vidvām̐so yad avidvām̐sas | mugdhāḥ kurvanty ṛtvijaḥ |
27.6.330.d: यद् विद्वाँसो यद् अविद्वाँसस् । मुग्धाः कुर्वन्त्य् ऋत्विजः ।
27.6.330.m: Whatever the officiating priests, knowing or unknowing, / do while confounded,

27.6.330.s: agnir mā tasmād enasaḥ śraddhā devī ca muñcatām̐ svāhā ||
27.6.330.d: अग्निर् मा तस्माद् एनसः श्रद्धा देवी च मुञ्चताँ स्वाहा ॥
27.6.330.m: from that sin may Agni / and the goddess Faith release me, svāhā!

27.6.330.s: yad antarikṣaṃ pṛthivīm uta dyām | yan mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā jihim̐sima |
27.6.330.d: यद् अन्तरिक्षं पृथिवीम् उत द्याम् । यन् मातरं पितरं वा जिहिँसिम ।
27.6.330.m: If we have harmed the intermediate space, the earth, or the sky, / or if [we have harmed] mother or father,

27.6.330.s: agnir mā tasmād enasas | gārhapatyaḥ pramuñcatu duritā yāni cakṛma karotu mām anehasam̐ svāhā ||
27.6.330.d: अग्निर् मा तस्माद् एनसस् । गार्हपत्यः प्रमुञ्चतु दुरिता यानि चकृम करोतु माम् अनेहसँ स्वाहा ॥
27.6.330.m: from that sin may Agni / Gārhapatya release me! / The evils that we have committed, / may he make me guiltless, svāhā!

27.6.330.s: brahmatve hautra ādhvaryava āgnīdhre yājamāne caika eva yajñe yat paryāṇi tan me devā rakṣantām | prāṇān me mā him̐siṣuḥ svāhā ||
27.6.330.d: ब्रह्मत्वे हौत्र आध्वर्यव आग्नीध्रे याजमाने चैक एव यज्ञे यत् पर्याणि तन् मे देवा रक्षन्ताम् । प्राणान् मे मा हिँसिषुः स्वाहा ॥
27.6.330.m: In the duties of the brahman, the hotṛ, the adhvaryu, the āgnīdhra, and the sacrificer, that I alone should go round in the sacrifice: / may the gods protect that of mine! / Let them not harm my vital breaths, svāhā!

27.6.330.s: ahaṃ brahmāham̐ hotāham adhvaryur aham agnīdhro 'haṃ yajamāna eka eva yajñe paryāṇi tan me devā rakṣantām | prāṇān me mā him̐siṣuḥ svāhā | iti |
27.6.330.d: अहं ब्रह्माहँ होताहम् अध्वर्युर् अहम् अग्नीध्रो ऽहं यजमान एक एव यज्ञे पर्याणि तन् मे देवा रक्षन्ताम् । प्राणान् मे मा हिँसिषुः स्वाहा । इति ।
27.6.330.m: I am the brahman priest, I am the hotṛ priest, I am the adhvaryu priest, I am the āgnīdhra priest, I am the sacrificer; that I alone should go round in the sacrifice: / may the gods protect that of mine! / Let them not harm my vital breaths, svāhā!'—thus.

27.6.330.s: ekādhvaryavaprāyaścittāni hutvānatarvedyāsīnaḥ sarvā devatā yajati | iti vijñāyate
27.6.330.d: एकाध्वर्यवप्रायश्चित्तानि हुत्वानतर्वेद्यासीनः सर्वा देवता यजति । इति विज्ञायते
27.6.330.m: Having offered the expiations for a single adhvaryu priest, seated within the altar, 'he sacrifices to all the deities'—so it is known [from scripture].
'When the offerings have passed by, / at the junctures, and during the first-fruits offerings,

27.6.330.s: araṇyor dhriyamāṇeṣu kathaṃ tantraṃ na lupyate ||
27.6.330.d: अरण्योर् ध्रियमाणेषु कथं तन्त्रं न लुप्यते ॥
27.6.330.m: while [the fires] are held in the two churning-sticks: / how is the ritual procedure not broken?'

27.6.331.s: śuciś ca pāvamānī ca tantumān atha pāthikṛt |
27.6.331.d: शुचिश् च पावमानी च तन्तुमान् अथ पाथिकृत् ।
27.6.331.m: 'The offering to [Agni] Śuci, to [Agni] Pāvamāna, / then to [Agni] Tantumant, and to [Agni] Pathikṛt:

27.6.331.s: etā iṣṭayaḥ prayoktavyās tatas tantraṃ na lupyate ||
27.6.331.d: एता इष्टयः प्रयोक्तव्यास् ततस् तन्त्रं न लुप्यते ॥
27.6.331.m: these sacrifices are to be employed; / then the ritual procedure is not broken.'

27.6.331.s: śuciḥ śodhayate pāpam | tantus tantaṃ na lopayet |
27.6.331.d: शुचिः शोधयते पापम् । तन्तुस् तन्तं न लोपयेत् ।
27.6.331.m: 'Śuci cleanses sin; / Tantumat will not let the thread be broken;

27.6.331.s: pathikṛt panthānam ārohet pāvamānī tu pāvayed iti nu baudhāyanasya kalpas |
27.6.331.d: पथिकृत् पन्थानम् आरोहेत् पावमानी तु पावयेद् इति नु बौधायनस्य कल्पस् ।
27.6.331.m: Pathikṛt would mount the path; while Pāvamāna would purify'—this is the ritual procedure of Baudhāyana.

27.6.331.s: darśe vyatīte pāthikṛtī kāryā paurṇamāse vyatīte vaiśvānarī kāryobhaye vyatīta ubhe kārye bahuṣu vyatīteṣv anvārambhaṇīyā syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
27.6.331.d: दर्शे व्यतीते पाथिकृती कार्या पौर्णमासे व्यतीते वैश्वानरी कार्योभये व्यतीत उभे कार्ये बहुषु व्यतीतेष्व् अन्वारम्भणीया स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
27.6.331.m: 'When the new moon sacrifice has lapsed, the offering to Pathikṛt is to be made; when the full moon sacrifice has lapsed, that to Vaiśvānara is to be made; when both have lapsed, both are to be made; when many have lapsed, the introductory offering (anvārambhaṇīyā) should be performed'—so says Śālīki.

27.7.331.s: atha yady araṇī jīrṇe syātāṃ jantubhir manthanena vā samāne nave anye araṇī āhṛtyāmāvāsyāyām upoṣya śvo bhūte dārśeneṣṭvā tasmiñ jīrṇe śakalīkṛtya gārhapatye prakṣipya prajvālya dakṣiṇenottarāraṇim ādāya savyenādharāraṇim upary agnau dhārayañ japati | udbudhyasvāgne praviśasva yonim anyāṃ devayajyāṃ voḍhave jātavedaḥ |
27.7.331.d: अथ यद्य् अरणी जीर्णे स्यातां जन्तुभिर् मन्थनेन वा समाने नवे अन्ये अरणी आहृत्यामावास्यायाम् उपोष्य श्वो भूते दार्शेनेष्ट्वा तस्मिञ् जीर्णे शकलीकृत्य गार्हपत्ये प्रक्षिप्य प्रज्वाल्य दक्षिणेनोत्तरारणिम् आदाय सव्येनाधरारणिम् उपर्य् अग्नौ धारयञ् जपति । उद्बुध्यस्वाग्ने प्रविशस्व योनिम् अन्यां देवयज्यां वोढवे जातवेदः ।
27.7.331.m: Now, if the two fire-drills are worn out by insects or by churning, having fetched two other similar, new fire-drills, having fasted on the new moon ritual, on the morrow having sacrificed with the new-moon sacrifice, having broken those worn-out ones into pieces, thrown them into the gārhapatya fire, and set them ablaze, taking the upper drill with the right hand and holding the lower drill over the fire with the left, he murmurs: "Awake, O Agni, enter into the other womb to bear the sacrifice to the gods, O Jātavedas!

27.7.331.s: araṇyā araṇim anusaṃkramasva jīrṇāṃ tanum ajīrṇayā nirṇudasva | iti |
27.7.331.d: अरण्या अरणिम् अनुसंक्रमस्व जीर्णां तनुम् अजीर्णया निर्णुदस्व । इति ।
27.7.331.m: "Cross over from fire-drill to fire-drill! / Expel the worn-out body with the unworn!" so [he says].

27.7.331.s: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas | ity araṇyor agnīn samārohya manthanasyāvṛtā gārhapatyaṃ mathitvā vihāraṃ kalpayitvā gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye saṃtanīṃ juhoti mano jyotir juṣatām ājyam | vicchinnaṃ yajñam̐ sam imaṃ dadhātu |
27.7.331.d: अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् । इत्य् अरण्योर् अग्नीन् समारोह्य मन्थनस्यावृता गार्हपत्यं मथित्वा विहारं कल्पयित्वा गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये संतनीं जुहोति मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् आज्यम् । विच्छिन्नं यज्ञँ सम् इमं दधातु ।
27.7.331.m: Having mounted the fires into the two fire-drills with: "This is thy seasonal womb...", having churned out the gārhapatya fire according to the rule of churning, having arranged the sacrificial ground, melted ghee over the gārhapatya fire, purified it, taken four ladlefuls into the offering ladle, he offers the continuity libation into the āhavanīya fire with: "May Mind, the Light, enjoy the ghee... / May it join together this broken sacrifice;

27.7.332.s: yā iṣṭā uṣaso nimrucaś ca tāḥ saṃdadhāmi haviṣā ghṛtena svāhā | iti |
27.7.332.d: या इष्टा उषसो निम्रुचश् च ताः संदधामि हविषा घृतेन स्वाहा । इति ।
27.7.332.m: "The dawns and evenings that have been sacrificed, / those I unite with oblation, with ghee, svāhā!" so [he says].
Then he parcels out a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Tantumat.

27.7.332.s: śarāvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti sā prasiddheṣṭiḥ saṃtiṣṭhate ||
27.7.332.d: शरावं दक्षिणां ददाति सा प्रसिद्धेष्टिः संतिष्ठते ॥
27.7.332.m: He gives an earthen bowl as the sacrificial fee; that well-known offering is completed.

27.8.332.s: athāraṇyor vyāpattiṃ vyākhyāsyāmas | aṣṭābhir nimittair vinaśyaty amedhyaśvacāṇḍālaśūdravāyasapatitarāsabharajasvalābhiś ca sam̐sparśane 'raṇyor vināśas
27.8.332.d: अथारण्योर् व्यापत्तिं व्याख्यास्यामस् । अष्टाभिर् निमित्तैर् विनश्यत्य् अमेध्यश्वचाण्डालशूद्रवायसपतितरासभरजस्वलाभिश् च सँस्पर्शने ऽरण्योर् विनाशस्
27.8.332.m: Now we shall explain the mishap concerning the two fire-drills: they are ruined by eight causes; contact with what is impure, a dog, a cāṇḍāla, a śūdra, a crow, a fallen person, a donkey, or a menstruating woman is the ruin of the two fire-drills.

27.8.332.s: tayor utsṛjya samāne nave anye araṇī āhṛtyāgnisaham agnyādheyam araṇigataṃ punarādheyaṃ naṣṭāraṇī apsu nimajjati bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau | iti |
27.8.332.d: तयोर् उत्सृज्य समाने नवे अन्ये अरणी आहृत्याग्निसहम् अग्न्याधेयम् अरणिगतं पुनराधेयं नष्टारणी अप्सु निमज्जति भवतं नः समनसौ । इति ।
27.8.332.m: Discarding them both, having fetched two other similar, new fire-drills, the fire-establishment carries fire; re-establishment resides in the fire-drills; he submerges the ruined fire-drills in water with: "Be of one mind with us..."

27.8.332.s: athottarāṃ chittvā bhittvā śakalīkṛtya manthanasāmārthyam̐ samāropaṇasāmarthyaṃ manthanaśeṣaṃ vā pramanthanaṃ ca kuryāt samastaśalyavarjam |
27.8.332.d: अथोत्तरां छित्त्वा भित्त्वा शकलीकृत्य मन्थनसामार्थ्यँ समारोपणसामर्थ्यं मन्थनशेषं वा प्रमन्थनं च कुर्यात् समस्तशल्यवर्जम् ।
27.8.332.m: Then, having cut, split, and reduced to pieces the upper one, he should make [a piece] fit for churning, or fit for mounting [the fire], or the residue of churning, and a churning peg, excluding the whole peg.

27.8.333.m: The mishap concerning the two fire-drills is concluded.

27.9.333.s: atha havirdoṣān vyākhyāsyāmo yathaitan nīlam akṣikāśātikā matkuṇaś cailaśirasoryūke kīṭo vā piṇḍakārī syāt kṣudrakīṭamakṣikāpipīlikāvarjam̐ śvamārjāranakulakukkuṭamarkaṭadhvāṅkṣākhupurīṣasikpadakeśamṛtanakhakunakhapūtidrapsasvedāsṛksnehāśrukāsakṣavathvārdraghraṇair vopahatam anyair vopahatam̐ rajasvalayā vā spṛṣṭaṃ tathāprayatena bhrūṇaghnena vā dṛṣṭaṃ tathāpapātreṇāmedhye vā deśe
27.9.333.d: अथ हविर्दोषान् व्याख्यास्यामो यथैतन् नीलम् अक्षिकाशातिका मत्कुणश् चैलशिरसोर्यूके कीटो वा पिण्डकारी स्यात् क्षुद्रकीटमक्षिकापिपीलिकावर्जँ श्वमार्जारनकुलकुक्कुटमर्कटध्वाङ्क्षाखुपुरीषसिक्पदकेशमृतनखकुनखपूतिद्रप्सस्वेदासृक्स्नेहाश्रुकासक्षवथ्वार्द्रघ्रणैर् वोपहतम् अन्यैर् वोपहतँ रजस्वलया वा स्पृष्टं तथाप्रयतेन भ्रूणघ्नेन वा दृष्टं तथापपात्रेणामेध्ये वा देशे
27.9.333.m: Now we shall explain the defects of the oblation: as when there is a blue fly, a clothes-moth, a bug, a louse of cloth or hair, or an insect that makes pellets, excluding tiny insects, flies, and ants; or when it is contaminated by the dung of a dog, cat, mongoose, cock, monkey, crow, or mouse; or by semen, hair, dead nail, bad nail, a putrid drop, sweat, blood, fat, tears, phlegm from coughing, or wet mucus from sneezing; or contaminated by other [substances]; or touched by a menstruating woman; or seen by one who is unpurified, or by a killer of an embryo, or by an outcast; or [if kept] in an impure place.
They throw the spilled, spoiled oblation into water,
or have it placed in cold ashes.

27.9.333.s: mindāhutī hutvāthānyan nirvaped ājyena vā pracaret | api tu khalu kṣiprasam̐skāram ājyaṃ bruvata iti
27.9.333.d: मिन्दाहुती हुत्वाथान्यन् निर्वपेद् आज्येन वा प्रचरेत् । अपि तु खलु क्षिप्रसँस्कारम् आज्यं ब्रुवत इति
27.9.333.m: Having offered the two Mindā libations, one should then apportion another [oblation] or proceed with clarified butter, for indeed they say: 'Clarified butter has a swift preparation.'

27.9.334.m: Having offered the two Mindā libations, he offers the Manasvatī libation.
That alone is the expiation for it.

27.10.334.s: athāto 'gnīnām udvātānāṃ prāyaścittis | āhutayaḥ sam̐skārārthā dṛṣṭā bhavanti
27.10.334.d: अथातो ऽग्नीनाम् उद्वातानां प्रायश्चित्तिस् । आहुतयः सँस्कारार्था दृष्टा भवन्ति
27.10.334.m: Now then, the expiation for extinguished fires: libations are seen [prescribed] for the purpose of consecration.

27.10.334.s: caturhotāra ity eke vyāhṛtaya ity eke
27.10.334.d: चतुर्होतार इत्य् एके व्याहृतय इत्य् एके
27.10.334.m: [The libations of] the Caturhotṛ formulas, say some; the sacred utterances (vyāhṛtis), say some;

27.10.334.s: mindāhutī ity eke manasvatīty eke mahāvyāhṛtaya ity eke |
27.10.334.d: मिन्दाहुती इत्य् एके मनस्वतीत्य् एके महाव्याहृतय इत्य् एके ।
27.10.334.m: the two Mindā libations, say some; the Manasvatī libation, say some; the great sacred utterances (mahāvyāhṛtis), say some.

27.10.334.s: atha yadi sarva evodvāyeyur āyatanebhyo 'rṇyor agnīn samārohya manthanasyāvṛtā gārhapatyaṃ manthati | itaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe agniḥ svād yoner adhi jātavedāḥ |
27.10.334.d: अथ यदि सर्व एवोद्वायेयुर् आयतनेभ्यो ऽर्ण्योर् अग्नीन् समारोह्य मन्थनस्यावृता गार्हपत्यं मन्थति । इतः प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निः स्वाद् योनेर् अधि जातवेदाः ।
27.10.334.m: Now, if all [the fires] should go out, having made the fires mount into the kindling sticks from their hearths, he churns out the gārhapatya fire according to the rite of churning, with: 'From here Agni Jātavedas was first born from his own womb;

27.10.334.s: sa gāyatriyā triṣṭubhā jagatyā devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan iti
27.10.334.d: स गायत्रिया त्रिष्टुभा जगत्या देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन् इति
27.10.334.m: knowing [the ritual], let him carry the oblation to the gods with the gāyatrī, triṣṭubh, and jagatī metres.'

27.10.334.s: chanodbhir evainam̐ svād yoneḥ prajanayati | iti brāhmaṇam
27.10.334.d: छनोद्भिर् एवैनँ स्वाद् योनेः प्रजनयति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
27.10.334.m: 'He generates him from his own womb by means of the metres,' says the brāhmaṇa passage.

27.10.334.s: atha yadi mathyamāno na jāyeta yatrānyaṃ paśyet tata āhṛtya hotavyam iti |
27.10.334.d: अथ यदि मथ्यमानो न जायेत यत्रान्यं पश्येत् तत आहृत्य होतव्यम् इति ।
27.10.334.m: Now, if when being churned he is not born, wherever he might see another [fire], having fetched [it] from there, one should make the offering.

27.10.334.s: athānyam atvaramāṇaḥ punar manthet | atha yadi jāta evodvāyet samāropaṇamantraṃ japitvā punar eva manthet |
27.10.334.d: अथान्यम् अत्वरमाणः पुनर् मन्थेत् । अथ यदि जात एवोद्वायेत् समारोपणमन्त्रं जपित्वा पुनर् एव मन्थेत् ।
27.10.334.m: Then, without hurrying, he should churn another again. Now, if when just born he should go out, having muttered the mantra for causing [the fires] to mount, he should just churn again.

27.10.334.s: athainam upatiṣṭhate | iṣe rayyai ramasva sahase dyumnāya | ūrje 'patyāya | iti |
27.10.334.d: अथैनम् उपतिष्ठते । इषे रय्यै रमस्व सहसे द्युम्नाय । ऊर्जे ऽपत्याय । इति ।
27.10.334.m: Then he waits upon it with: 'Rest for refreshment, for wealth! For might, for splendor! For strength, for offspring!'

27.10.335.s: athainam upasaminddhe sārasvatau tvotsau samindhātām | samrāḍ asi virāḍ asi | iti |
27.10.335.d: अथैनम् उपसमिन्द्धे सारस्वतौ त्वोत्सौ समिन्धाताम् । सम्राड् असि विराड् असि । इति ।
27.10.335.m: Then he kindles it with: 'May the two streams of Sarasvatī kindle you! You are the sovereign ruler; you are the universal ruler!'

27.10.335.s: athainam upasamādhāyānvāhāryapacanam āhṛtya jvalantam āhavanīyam uddhṛtya nyupyopasamādhāya gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā daśahotāraṃ manasānudrutyāhavanīye juhoty anvārabdhe yajamāne svāhā | iti |
27.10.335.d: अथैनम् उपसमाधायान्वाहार्यपचनम् आहृत्य ज्वलन्तम् आहवनीयम् उद्धृत्य न्युप्योपसमाधाय गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा दशहोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्याहवनीये जुहोत्य् अन्वारब्धे यजमाने स्वाहा । इति ।
27.10.335.m: Then, having built it up, having fetched the anvāhāryapacana fire, having taken out the blazing āhavanīya fire, having poured down [earth] and built it up, having melted clarified butter on the gārhapatya fire and purified it, having taken four ladlings in the ladle, having recited the Daśahotṛ formula in mind, while the sacrificer holds onto him from behind, he offers into the āhavanīya fire with: 'Svāhā!'

27.10.335.s: atha pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya gārhapatye daśātmakaṃ brāhmaṇa ekahotety etasyānuvākasya daśa sruvāhutīs |
27.10.335.d: अथ प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य गार्हपत्ये दशात्मकं ब्राह्मण एकहोतेत्य् एतस्यानुवाकस्य दश स्रुवाहुतीस् ।
27.10.335.m: Then, having turned around clockwise, having run westward, [he offers] into the gārhapatya fire the ten ladle libations of the section having ten components in the brāhmaṇa [beginning with] 'Ekahotā'.

27.10.335.s: atha yady anvāhāryapacana udvāyed gārhapatyād enam uddhṛtyānvāhāryapacane caturhotāraṃ juhoti gārhapatye daśātmakam
27.10.335.d: अथ यद्य् अन्वाहार्यपचन उद्वायेद् गार्हपत्याद् एनम् उद्धृत्यान्वाहार्यपचने चतुर्होतारं जुहोति गार्हपत्ये दशात्मकम्
27.10.335.m: Now, if the anvāhāryapacana fire should go out, having taken it out from the gārhapatya fire, he offers [with] the Caturhotṛ formula into the anvāhāryapacana fire, [and] the ten-component [formula] into the gārhapatya fire.

27.10.335.s: atha yady āhavanīya udvāyed gārhapatyād enam uddhṛtyāhavanīye pañcahotāraṃ juhoti gārhapatye daśātmakam
27.10.335.d: अथ यद्य् आहवनीय उद्वायेद् गार्हपत्याद् एनम् उद्धृत्याहवनीये पञ्चहोतारं जुहोति गार्हपत्ये दशात्मकम्
27.10.335.m: Now, if the āhavanīya fire should go out, having taken it out from the gārhapatya fire, he offers [with] the Pañcahotṛ formula into the āhavanīya fire, [and] the ten-component [formula] into the gārhapatya fire.

27.10.335.s: atha yadi savanagatānām agnīnām agnīdhrīya udvāyec chālāmukhīyād enam uddhṛtyāgnīdhrīye ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ juhoti śālāmukhīye daśātmakam
27.10.335.d: अथ यदि सवनगतानाम् अग्नीनाम् अग्नीध्रीय उद्वायेच् छालामुखीयाद् एनम् उद्धृत्याग्नीध्रीये षड्ढोतारं जुहोति शालामुखीये दशात्मकम्
27.10.335.m: Now, if the āgnīdhrīya fire among the fires belonging to the soma pressings should go out, having taken it out from the śālāmukhīya fire, he offers [with] the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula into the āgnīdhrīya fire, [and] the ten-component [formula] into the śālāmukhīya fire.

27.10.335.s: atha yady auttaravedika āhavanīya udvāyed āgnīdhrīyād enam uddhṛtyauttaravedika āhavanīye saptahotāraṃ juhoty āgnīdhrīye daśātmakam ||
27.10.335.d: अथ यद्य् औत्तरवेदिक आहवनीय उद्वायेद् आग्नीध्रीयाद् एनम् उद्धृत्यौत्तरवेदिक आहवनीये सप्तहोतारं जुहोत्य् आग्नीध्रीये दशात्मकम् ॥
27.10.335.m: Now, if the āhavanīya fire on the high altar should go out, having taken it out from the āgnīdhrīya fire, he offers [with] the Saptahotṛ formula into the āhavanīya fire on the high altar, [and] the ten-component [formula] into the āgnīdhrīya fire.

27.11.335.s: etayaivāvṛtaikasminn udvāte dvayor vā prativibhajya hotṝñ juhuyād vyāhṛtīś ced vyastāḥ samastāś ca juhuyāt tathā mindāhutī juhuyān manasvatīṃ ced āhavanīye juhuyāt saiṣājasrāṇām anvāhitānām̐ savanagatānāṃ cāgnīnām udvātānāṃ prāyaścittir etad eva homakāle 'nvādhānavarjam
27.11.335.d: एतयैवावृतैकस्मिन्न् उद्वाते द्वयोर् वा प्रतिविभज्य होतॄञ् जुहुयाद् व्याहृतीश् चेद् व्यस्ताः समस्ताश् च जुहुयात् तथा मिन्दाहुती जुहुयान् मनस्वतीं चेद् आहवनीये जुहुयात् सैषाजस्राणाम् अन्वाहितानाँ सवनगतानां चाग्नीनाम् उद्वातानां प्रायश्चित्तिर् एतद् एव होमकाले ऽन्वाधानवर्जम्
27.11.335.m: According to this very rite, when one or two fires have gone out, he should offer [with] the Hotṛ formulas divided respectively; and if [he offers with] the sacred utterances, he should offer them both separately and combined; likewise he should offer the two Mindā libations; and if [he offers] the Manasvatī libation, he should offer it into the āhavanīya fire. This is the expiation for extinguished fires—those kept perpetually burning, those to which fuel has been added, and those belonging to the soma pressings. This very [procedure is followed] at the time of offering, with the exception of adding fuel.

27.11.336.s: atha yasyāgnir uddhṛto 'hute 'gnihotra udvāyed iti yathāsūtraṃ vā kuryād api vā gārhapatyād idhmam ādīpya manthanam adhimanthanam upasamindhanam ity etān mantrān nigaded api vā jyotiṣmatīm iṣṭiṃ nirvaped api vā jyotiṣmatībhyām ṛgbhyāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyād api vā jyotiṣmatīm̐ sruvāhutiṃ juhuyāt | agnaye jyotiṣmate svāhā | itīṣṭapūrṇāhutisruvāhutīnāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ vidhiṃ balīyām̐sam ācāryā bruvate
27.11.336.d: अथ यस्याग्निर् उद्धृतो ऽहुते ऽग्निहोत्र उद्वायेद् इति यथासूत्रं वा कुर्याद् अपि वा गार्हपत्याद् इध्मम् आदीप्य मन्थनम् अधिमन्थनम् उपसमिन्धनम् इत्य् एतान् मन्त्रान् निगदेद् अपि वा ज्योतिष्मतीम् इष्टिं निर्वपेद् अपि वा ज्योतिष्मतीभ्याम् ऋग्भ्यां पूर्णाहुतिं जुहुयाद् अपि वा ज्योतिष्मतीँ स्रुवाहुतिं जुहुयात् । अग्नये ज्योतिष्मते स्वाहा । इतीष्टपूर्णाहुतिस्रुवाहुतीनां पूर्वं पूर्वं विधिं बलीयाँसम् आचार्या ब्रुवते
27.11.336.m: Now, in the case of one whose [āhavanīya] fire has been taken out and goes out before the agnihotra has been offered, he may act according to the sūtra; or, having kindled kindling wood from the gārhapatya fire, he may recite these formulas: churning, churning upon, and kindling; or he may perform an iṣṭi to [Agni] Jyotiṣmat; or he may offer a full libation with two verses addressed to Jyotiṣmat; or he may offer a ladle libation addressed to Jyotiṣmat with: 'To Agni Jyotiṣmat, svāhā!' Among an iṣṭi, a full libation, and a ladle libation, the teachers declare each preceding rule to be stronger.
'Whatever simpler variations / are noticed here and there,

27.11.336.s: karma tair na prasaṅgena kuryād āpatsu tad dhanam ||
27.11.336.d: कर्म तैर् न प्रसङ्गेन कुर्याद् आपत्सु तद् धनम् ॥
27.11.336.m: one should not perform the rite with them by attachment; / that is wealth in emergencies.
One should diligently ascertain / the variations from all the Vedas,

27.11.336.s: karmaṇāṃ pravicārārtham āpatsu ca samāpnuyāt | iti ||
27.11.336.d: कर्मणां प्रविचारार्थम् आपत्सु च समाप्नुयात् । इति ॥
27.11.336.m: for the purpose of deliberate application to rites, / and he should complete them in times of distress.'

27.11.337.s: yadi prasaṅgena hutaṃ ca laukye mugdhair vā bālair hutam̐ syād vihṛtaṃ ca patnyā tān araṇyor agnīn samārohyodavasāya mathitvāgnīn vihṛtya pūrṇāhutis tantumatī ca kāryeti |
27.11.337.d: यदि प्रसङ्गेन हुतं च लौक्ये मुग्धैर् वा बालैर् हुतँ स्याद् विहृतं च पत्न्या तान् अरण्योर् अग्नीन् समारोह्योदवसाय मथित्वाग्नीन् विहृत्य पूर्णाहुतिस् तन्तुमती च कार्येति ।
27.11.337.m: If through attachment an offering has been made, and that into common fire, or an offering has been made by confused people or by boys, or [the fires] have been spread by the sacrificer's wife, having caused those fires to mount into the kindling sticks, having migrated, having churned and spread the fires, a full libation and the Tantumatī rite must be performed.

27.11.337.s: atha yady aprasaṅgena hutaṃ ca laukye mughair vā bālair hutam̐ syād vihṛtaṃ ca patnyā tān vyāhṛtībhir vihṛtya pūrṇāhutis tantumatī ca kāryeti ||
27.11.337.d: अथ यद्य् अप्रसङ्गेन हुतं च लौक्ये मुघैर् वा बालैर् हुतँ स्याद् विहृतं च पत्न्या तान् व्याहृतीभिर् विहृत्य पूर्णाहुतिस् तन्तुमती च कार्येति ॥
27.11.337.m: Now, if without attachment an offering has been made, and that into common fire, or an offering has been made by confused people or by boys, or [the fires] have been spread by the sacrificer's wife, having spread them with the sacred utterances, a full libation and the Tantumatī rite must be performed.

27.12.337.s: atha vai bhavati nirṛtir vā etasya yajñaṃ gṛhṇāti yasyā kasyāṃ ca haviḥ kṣāyati yady avadānāni vindanti nātra prāyaścittaṃ kurvanti
27.12.337.d: अथ वै भवति निरृतिर् वा एतस्य यज्ञं गृह्णाति यस्या कस्यां च हविः क्षायति यद्य् अवदानानि विन्दन्ति नात्र प्रायश्चित्तं कुर्वन्ति
27.12.337.m: Now indeed it is said: / 'Destruction (Nirṛti) seizes the sacrifice of him whose oblation burns in any vessel whatsoever. If they find portions [available], they do not perform an expiation on this point.'

27.12.337.d: दहति ह वा एषो ऽध्वर्युर् अवदानानि

27.12.337.s: samūhaitāny eṣa tarpayati dahati ha vā eṣa ya ājyaṃ purastād ahutvāthāvadānāni juhoty ājyenopariṣṭān nābhighārayati
27.12.337.d: समूहैतान्य् एष तर्पयति दहति ह वा एष य आज्यं पुरस्ताद् अहुत्वाथावदानानि जुहोत्य् आज्येनोपरिष्टान् नाभिघारयति
27.12.337.m: having swept these together, he satisfies them. / Indeed, he burns them who, without first offering clarified butter, then offers the portions, and does not baste [them] from above with clarified butter.'

27.12.338.s: teṣām̐ saṃdagdhānāṃ na devāstṛpyanti na yajamānas | atha haināny eṣa saṃtarpayati ya ājyaṃ purastād dhutvāthāvadānāni juhoty ājyenopariṣṭād abhighārayati
27.12.338.d: तेषाँ संदग्धानां न देवास्तृप्यन्ति न यजमानस् । अथ हैनान्य् एष संतर्पयति य आज्यं पुरस्ताद् धुत्वाथावदानानि जुहोत्य् आज्येनोपरिष्टाद् अभिघारयति
27.12.338.m: When they are scorched, neither the gods nor the sacrificer are satisfied. But he satisfies them who, having first offered clarified butter, then offers the portions and bastes [them] from above with clarified butter.

27.12.338.s: teṣām̐ saṃtṛptānāṃ tṛpyanti devās tṛpyati yajamānas |
27.12.338.d: तेषाँ संतृप्तानां तृप्यन्ति देवास् तृप्यति यजमानस् ।
27.12.338.m: When they are satisfied, the gods are satisfied, and the sacrificer is satisfied.

27.12.338.s: atha yady āgneyāt puroḍāśād agnīṣomau yajetāgnīṣomīyād vāgniṃ yajeta naitat pradānam iti |
27.12.338.d: अथ यद्य् आग्नेयात् पुरोडाशाद् अग्नीषोमौ यजेताग्नीषोमीयाद् वाग्निं यजेत नैतत् प्रदानम् इति ।
27.12.338.m: Now, if he should sacrifice to Agni-Soma from the cake for Agni, or sacrifice to Agni from [the cake] for Agni-Soma, that is not an offering [proper].

27.12.338.s: āhavanīye sruvāhutiṃ juhuyāt | yad vo devā atipādayāni | iti
27.12.338.d: आहवनीये स्रुवाहुतिं जुहुयात् । यद् वो देवा अतिपादयानि । इति
27.12.338.m: He should offer a ladle libation into the āhavanīya fire with: 'Whatever of yours, O gods, I might cause to fail...'

27.12.338.s: devapavitram āgneyyo yājyāpuro'nuvākyā devapavitram aindriyo devapavitraṃ prajāpatyā devapavitraṃ vyāhṛtaya iti |
27.12.338.d: देवपवित्रम् आग्नेय्यो याज्यापुरोऽनुवाक्या देवपवित्रम् ऐन्द्रियो देवपवित्रं प्रजापत्या देवपवित्रं व्याहृतय इति ।
27.12.338.m: The Devapavitra consists of the offering and introductory verses addressed to Agni; the Devapavitra consists of those addressed to Indra; the Devapavitra consists of those addressed to Prajāpati; the Devapavitra consists of the sacred utterances.

27.12.338.s: atha yadi hotā yājyāpuro'nuvākyāsu muhyeta sarvābhir āgneyībhir yajeteti
27.12.338.d: अथ यदि होता याज्यापुरोऽनुवाक्यासु मुह्येत सर्वाभिर् आग्नेयीभिर् यजेतेति
27.12.338.m: Now, if the hotṛ priest should become confused regarding the offering and introductory verses, he should sacrifice with all [verses] addressed to Agni.
It is known [from sacred tradition]: 'Agni is all deities.'

27.12.338.s: aindrībhis | vijñāyate | indro vai sarvā devatās | iti
27.12.338.d: ऐन्द्रीभिस् । विज्ञायते । इन्द्रो वै सर्वा देवतास् । इति
27.12.338.m: [Or] with [verses] addressed to Indra; it is known: 'Indra is all deities.'

27.12.338.s: prājāpatyābhis | vijñāyate prajāpatiḥ sarvā devatās | iti vyāhṛtībhis |
27.12.338.d: प्राजापत्याभिस् । विज्ञायते प्रजापतिः सर्वा देवतास् । इति व्याहृतीभिस् ।
27.12.338.m: [Or] with [verses] addressed to Prajāpati; it is known: 'Prajāpati is all deities.' [Or] with the sacred utterances;

27.12.338.s: vijñāyate sarvā vā ṛcaḥ sarvāṇi sāmāni sarvāṇi yajūm̐ṣi yad vyāhṛtayas | iti |
27.12.338.d: विज्ञायते सर्वा वा ऋचः सर्वाणि सामानि सर्वाणि यजूँषि यद् व्याहृतयस् । इति ।
27.12.338.m: it is known: 'All ṛcs, all sāmans, all yajuses are what the sacred utterances are.'

27.12.338.s: atha yadi yajamāno yājamāneṣu muhyeta vyāhṛtībhir evāntareṇa vedyutkarau prapadanaṃ vyāhṛtībhir evopaniṣkramaṇaṃ vyāhṛtībhir evānumantraṇam |
27.12.338.d: अथ यदि यजमानो याजमानेषु मुह्येत व्याहृतीभिर् एवान्तरेण वेद्युत्करौ प्रपदनं व्याहृतीभिर् एवोपनिष्क्रमणं व्याहृतीभिर् एवानुमन्त्रणम् ।
27.12.338.m: Now, if the sacrificer should become confused regarding the duties of the sacrificer, the stepping between the altar and the rubbish heap should be done with the sacred utterances alone, the stepping out with the sacred utterances alone, and the accompanying mantras with the sacred utterances alone.

27.12.339.s: vijñāyate sarvā vā ṛcaḥ sarvāṇi sāmāni sarvāṇi yajūm̐ṣi yad vyāhṛtayas | iti |
27.12.339.d: विज्ञायते सर्वा वा ऋचः सर्वाणि सामानि सर्वाणि यजूँषि यद् व्याहृतयस् । इति ।
27.12.339.m: It is known: 'All ṛcs, all sāmans, all yajuses are what the sacred utterances are.'

27.12.339.s: upāsate ha vai yajñaṃ devā antaritā idam u no havir na hutaṃ tad dhoṣyata iti |
27.12.339.d: उपासते ह वै यज्ञं देवा अन्तरिता इदम् उ नो हविर् न हुतं तद् धोष्यत इति ।
27.12.339.m: The gods indeed wait upon the sacrifice, excluded [saying]: 'This oblation of ours has not been offered; he will offer it now.'

27.12.339.s: ā sviṣṭakṛta ity eke | eḍāyā ity eke | ānuyājebhya ity eke |
27.12.339.d: आ स्विष्टकृत इत्य् एके । एडाया इत्य् एके । आनुयाजेभ्य इत्य् एके ।
27.12.339.m: "Up to the sviṣṭakṛt offering," say some; "up to the iḍā," say some; "up to the after-offerings," say some;

27.12.339.s: ā śaṃyuvākād ity eke | ā samiṣṭayajuṣa ity eke |
27.12.339.d: आ शंयुवाकाद् इत्य् एके । आ समिष्टयजुष इत्य् एके ।
27.12.339.m: "up to the śaṃyuvāka recitation," say some; "up to the samiṣṭayajus offering," say some.

27.12.339.s: ūrdhvaṃ cet samiṣṭayajuṣaḥ smaret sam̐sthāpyaitām iṣṭim anyām iṣṭim anulbaṇāṃ tanvīta
27.12.339.d: ऊर्ध्वं चेत् समिष्टयजुषः स्मरेत् सँस्थाप्यैताम् इष्टिम् अन्याम् इष्टिम् अनुल्बणां तन्वीत
27.12.339.m: If he should remember after the samiṣṭayajus offering, then, having concluded this sacrifice, he should perform another sacrifice free from defect.

27.12.339.s: yajño ha vai yajñasya prāyaścittis | iti vijñāyate ||
27.12.339.d: यज्ञो ह वै यज्ञस्य प्रायश्चित्तिस् । इति विज्ञायते ॥
27.12.339.m: "Sacrifice indeed is the atonement of sacrifice," it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

27.13.339.s: atha sāṃnāyyaduho dhayeyuś ced vatsā vāyavyayā yavāgvā sāyaṃ yajeta |
27.13.339.d: अथ सांनाय्यदुहो धयेयुश् चेद् वत्सा वायव्यया यवाग्वा सायं यजेत ।
27.13.339.m: Now, if the calves should suck the cows to be milked for the curd-and-milk oblation, he should sacrifice in the evening with barley gruel sacred to Vāyu.

27.13.339.s: apy ekasyāṃ dugdhāyāṃ na dhītāṃ dohayet | dugdhābhiḥ sam̐sthāpyādugdhānāṃ vatsān apākṛtya śvaḥ sāṃnāyyena yajeta
27.13.339.d: अप्य् एकस्यां दुग्धायां न धीतां दोहयेत् । दुग्धाभिः सँस्थाप्यादुग्धानां वत्सान् अपाकृत्य श्वः सांनाय्येन यजेत
27.13.339.m: Even if one cow has been milked, he should not milk one that has been sucked. Having concluded [the rite] with the milked ones, having removed the calves of the unmilked ones, he should sacrifice the next day with the curd-and-milk oblation.

27.13.340.s: sāyaṃdohaś ced ārtim ārched indrāya vrīhīn nirupyopavased iti yathāsamāmnātam
27.13.340.d: सायंदोहश् चेद् आर्तिम् आर्छेद् इन्द्राय व्रीहीन् निरुप्योपवसेद् इति यथासमाम्नातम्
27.13.340.m: If the evening milking should suffer mishap, having measured out rice for Indra, he should observe the fast, as is handed down in the traditional text.

27.13.340.s: api vā prātardohaṃ dvaidhaṃ kṛtvānyatarad ātacya sāyaṃdohasthāne kuryāc chṛtasthāna itarat
27.13.340.d: अपि वा प्रातर्दोहं द्वैधं कृत्वान्यतरद् आतच्य सायंदोहस्थाने कुर्याच् छृतस्थान इतरत्
27.13.340.m: Or, having divided the morning milking into two, having curdled one part, he should put it in the place of the evening milking, and the other in the place of the boiled milk.

27.13.340.s: prātardohaś ced ārtim ārcched aindraṃ vā māhendraṃ vā puroḍāśaṃ nirupya tena dadhnā saha pracaret |
27.13.340.d: प्रातर्दोहश् चेद् आर्तिम् आर्च्छेद् ऐन्द्रं वा माहेन्द्रं वा पुरोडाशं निरुप्य तेन दध्ना सह प्रचरेत् ।
27.13.340.m: If the morning milking should suffer mishap, having measured out a cake for Indra or for Mahendra, he should proceed [with the offering] of it along with the curd.

27.13.340.s: ubhayaṃ ced ārtim ārcched aindraṃ pañcaśarāvam odanaṃ nirvaped iti
27.13.340.d: उभयं चेद् आर्तिम् आर्च्छेद् ऐन्द्रं पञ्चशरावम् ओदनं निर्वपेद् इति
27.13.340.m: If both should suffer mishap, he should measure out a mess of boiled rice in five platters for Indra.
Having proceeded in the well-known manner with the offering to Agni, he should proceed with the offering to Indra.

27.13.340.s: sarvāṇi ced dhavīm̐ṣi duṣyeyur naśyeyur apahareyur vājyenaitā devatāḥ pratisaṃkhyāyam iṣṭvaitām iṣṭim anyām iṣṭim anulbaṇāṃ tanvīta
27.13.340.d: सर्वाणि चेद् धवीँषि दुष्येयुर् नश्येयुर् अपहरेयुर् वाज्येनैता देवताः प्रतिसंख्यायम् इष्ट्वैताम् इष्टिम् अन्याम् इष्टिम् अनुल्बणां तन्वीत
27.13.340.m: If all the oblations should be spoiled, lost, or carried off, having mentally recited these deities with ghee, having performed this sacrifice, he should perform another sacrifice free from defect.

27.13.340.s: yajño ha vai yajñasya prāyaścittis | iti vijñāyate ||
27.13.340.d: यज्ञो ह वै यज्ञस्य प्रायश्चित्तिस् । इति विज्ञायते ॥
27.13.340.m: "Sacrifice indeed is the atonement of sacrifice," it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

27.14.340.m: Now, therefore, we shall explain the recitation over the offerings not handed down in the metrical text.

27.14.340.s: vaimṛdham iṣṭam anumantrayate | indrasya vaimṛdhasyāhaṃ devayajyayedriyāvy asapatno vīryavāñ chrīmān bhūyāsam iti | "asapatno vīryavān bhūyāsam" iti vā
27.14.340.d: वैमृधम् इष्टम् अनुमन्त्रयते । इन्द्रस्य वैमृधस्याहं देवयज्ययेद्रियाव्य् असपत्नो वीर्यवाञ् छ्रीमान् भूयासम् इति । "असपत्नो वीर्यवान् भूयासम्" इति वा
27.14.340.m: He recites over the sacrifice offered to [Indra] Vaimṛdha: "Through the divine sacrifice to Indra Vaimṛdha may I be energetic, free from rivals, full of valour, full of splendour!" or "May I be free from rivals, full of valour!"

27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to Paryanya may I possess good pastures!"

27.14.341.s: somasyāhaṃ devayajyayā pra prajayā ca paśubhiś ca janiṣīya "suretā reto dhiṣīya" | iti vā
27.14.341.d: सोमस्याहं देवयज्यया प्र प्रजया च पशुभिश् च जनिषीय "सुरेता रेतो धिषीय" । इति वा
27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to Soma may I propagate with offspring and cattle!" or "Possessing good seed, may I deposit seed!"

27.14.341.s: savitur ahaṃ devayajyayā svastimān paśumān bhūyāsam |
27.14.341.d: सवितुर् अहं देवयज्यया स्वस्तिमान् पशुमान् भूयासम् ।
27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to Savitar may I be prosperous, possessing cattle!"

27.14.341.s: sarasvatyā ahaṃ devayajyayā vācam annādyaṃ puṣeyam |
27.14.341.d: सरस्वत्या अहं देवयज्यया वाचम् अन्नाद्यं पुषेयम् ।
27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to Sarasvatī may I nourish speech and food!"

27.14.341.s: sarasvato 'haṃ devayajyayā śraddhāmanā bhūyāsam | pūṣṇo 'haṃ devayajyayā puṣṭimān paśumān bhūyāsam |
27.14.341.d: सरस्वतो ऽहं देवयज्यया श्रद्धामना भूयासम् । पूष्णो ऽहं देवयज्यया पुष्टिमान् पशुमान् भूयासम् ।
27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to Sarasvat may I be devoted in mind!" / "Through the divine sacrifice to Pūṣan may I be thriving, possessing cattle!"
"Through the divine sacrifice to the Maruts may I prosper through the vital breaths!"

27.14.341.s: viśveṣāṃ devānām ahaṃ devayajyayā prāṇaiḥ sāyujyaṃ gameyam |
27.14.341.d: विश्वेषां देवानाम् अहं देवयज्यया प्राणैः सायुज्यं गमेयम् ।
27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to the All-gods may I attain union through the vital breaths!"

27.14.341.s: dyāvāpṛthivyor ahaṃ devayajyayobhayor lokayor ṛdhyāsam | "bhūmānaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam" iti vā
27.14.341.d: द्यावापृथिव्योर् अहं देवयज्ययोभयोर् लोकयोर् ऋध्यासम् । "भूमानं प्रतिष्ठां गमेयम्" इति वा
27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to Heaven and Earth may I prosper in both worlds!" or "May I attain abundance and a firm footing!"

27.14.341.s: vājinām ahaṃ devayajyayā retasvī bhūyāsam | varuṇasyāhaṃ devayajyayā dharmabhāg bhūyāsam |
27.14.341.d: वाजिनाम् अहं देवयज्यया रेतस्वी भूयासम् । वरुणस्याहं देवयज्यया धर्मभाग् भूयासम् ।
27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to the Vājins may I be virile!" / "Through the divine sacrifice to Varuṇa may I have a share in order!"

27.14.341.s: kasyāhaṃ devayajyayā śaviṣṭho bhūyāsam | viśvakarmaṇo 'haṃ devayajyayā viśvāni karmāṇy avarundhīya |
27.14.341.d: कस्याहं देवयज्यया शविष्ठो भूयासम् । विश्वकर्मणो ऽहं देवयज्यया विश्वानि कर्माण्य् अवरुन्धीय ।
27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to Ka may I become strongest!" / "Through the divine sacrifice to Viśvakarman may I secure all actions!"
"Through the divine sacrifice to Aditi may I be freed from distress!"
"Through the divine sacrifice to Vāyu may I be the possessor of treasure!"

27.14.341.s: sūryasyāhaṃ devayajyayā sudṛśīko bhūyāsam agnāviṣṇavor ahaṃ devayajyayā vīryavān bhūyāsam |
27.14.341.d: सूर्यस्याहं देवयज्यया सुदृशीको भूयासम् अग्नाविष्णवोर् अहं देवयज्यया वीर्यवान् भूयासम् ।
27.14.341.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to Sūrya may I be fair to look upon!" / "Through the divine sacrifice to Agni and Viṣṇu may I be full of valour!"
"Through the divine sacrifice to Viṣṇu may I become enveloped in rays!"

27.14.342.s: aryamṇo 'haṃ devayajyayā svargaṃ lokaṃ gameyam iti
27.14.342.d: अर्यम्णो ऽहं देवयज्यया स्वर्गं लोकं गमेयम् इति
27.14.342.m: "Through the divine sacrifice to Aryaman may I go to the heavenly world!"

27.14.342.s: yathādevatam iṣṭam anumantrayata evam anādiṣṭān aṣṭākapālān āgneyavikārān ācakṣata ekādaśakapālān agnīṣomīyavikārān dvādaśakapālān vaiśvadevavikārān ekakapālaṃ bhūmikapālaṃ ca dyāvāpṛthivyavikārāv ato 'nyān āgneyavikārān |
27.14.342.d: यथादेवतम् इष्टम् अनुमन्त्रयत एवम् अनादिष्टान् अष्टाकपालान् आग्नेयविकारान् आचक्षत एकादशकपालान् अग्नीषोमीयविकारान् द्वादशकपालान् वैश्वदेवविकारान् एककपालं भूमिकपालं च द्यावापृथिव्यविकाराव् अतो ऽन्यान् आग्नेयविकारान् ।
27.14.342.m: Thus he recites over the sacrifice according to the deity. They declare unprescribed cakes on eight potsherds to be modifications of the offering to Agni; cakes on eleven potsherds to be modifications of the offering to Agni and Soma; cakes on twelve potsherds to be modifications of the offering to the All-gods; a cake on one potsherd and a cake baked on the ground to be modifications of the offering to Heaven and Earth; and other [cakes] than these to be modifications of the offering to Agni.
Curd, milk, clotted curd, and animal victims are modifications of the curd-and-milk oblation; the offering to the tree is a modification of the sviṣṭakṛt offering.
They declare whispered offerings to be modifications of the whispered offering.

27.14.342.s: athāpy udāharanti haviḥsāmānyaṃ devatāsāmānyaṃ kapālasāmānyam iti havirdevatākapālasāmānye haviḥsāmānyaṃ devatāsāmānyaṃ kapālasāmānyam iti havirdevatākapālasāmānye haviḥsāmānyaṃ balīya iti |
27.14.342.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति हविःसामान्यं देवतासामान्यं कपालसामान्यम् इति हविर्देवताकपालसामान्ये हविःसामान्यं देवतासामान्यं कपालसामान्यम् इति हविर्देवताकपालसामान्ये हविःसामान्यं बलीय इति ।
27.14.342.m: Moreover, they also cite: "commonality of oblation, commonality of deity, commonality of potsherds"; when there is commonality of oblation, deity, and potsherds, commonality of oblation is the strongest.

27.14.342.s: api vāsya yajñasyāgura ud ṛcam aśīyeti sārvatrikam ||
27.14.342.d: अपि वास्य यज्ञस्यागुर उद् ऋचम् अशीयेति सार्वत्रिकम् ॥
27.14.342.m: Or rather, the formula: "Having made the intention for this sacrifice, may I attain the verse" applies everywhere.

28.1.343.s: atha vai bhavati yaḥ pāpayakṣmagṛhītaḥ syāt | yo vāparudhyeta devebhya ṛṣibhyaḥ pitṛbhyo gobhyo brāhmaṇebhyas tenābhiśasto 'bhiśasyamāno vā rahasyeṣṭyā yajeta | iti |
28.1.343.d: अथ वै भवति यः पापयक्ष्मगृहीतः स्यात् । यो वापरुध्येत देवेभ्य ऋषिभ्यः पितृभ्यो गोभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यस् तेनाभिशस्तो ऽभिशस्यमानो वा रहस्येष्ट्या यजेत । इति ।
28.1.343.m:
Now indeed it is said:
"One who is seized by consumption, or who is excluded from the gods, the seers, the ancestors, cows, and brāhmaṇas, or being accused or under accusation by him, should sacrifice with the secret sacrifice (rahasyeṣṭi)."
Intending to sacrifice with this sacrifice, he prepares gold.

28.1.343.s: tasyāḥ prajñāta upavasathas | atha prātarhute 'gnihotre purāpāṃ praṇayanād gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye juhoty anvārabdhe yajamāne yena devāḥ pavitreṇa | ātmānaṃ punate sadā |
28.1.343.d: तस्याः प्रज्ञात उपवसथस् । अथ प्रातर्हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे पुरापां प्रणयनाद् गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये जुहोत्य् अन्वारब्धे यजमाने येन देवाः पवित्रेण । आत्मानं पुनते सदा ।
28.1.343.m:
Its fast-day is well known.
Then, when the morning agnihotra has been offered and before carrying forward the waters, having melted clarified butter on the gārhapatya fire and purified it, taking four ladlings in the ladle, he offers in the āhavanīya fire while the sacrificer holds onto him: "With what purifier the gods / purify themselves always,

28.1.343.s: tena sahasradhāreṇa pāvamānyaḥ punantu mā svāhā | iti |
28.1.343.d: तेन सहस्रधारेण पावमान्यः पुनन्तु मा स्वाहा । इति ।
28.1.343.m: with that thousand-streamed one, / may the purifying verses purify me, svāhā!"

28.1.343.s: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīya eva juhoti prājāpatyaṃ pavitram | śatodyāmam̐ hiraṇmayam |
28.1.343.d: अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीय एव जुहोति प्राजापत्यं पवित्रम् । शतोद्यामँ हिरण्मयम् ।
28.1.343.m: Taking another four ladlings, he offers in the āhavanīya fire itself: "The purifier belonging to Prajāpati, / stretching out a hundredfold, made of gold,

28.1.343.s: tena brahmavido vayam | pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe svāhā | iti | aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīya eva juhoti | indraḥ sunītī saha mā punātu somaḥ svastyā varuṇaḥ samīcyā |
28.1.343.d: तेन ब्रह्मविदो वयम् । पूतं ब्रह्म पुनीमहे स्वाहा । इति । अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीय एव जुहोति । इन्द्रः सुनीती सह मा पुनातु सोमः स्वस्त्या वरुणः समीच्या ।
28.1.343.m:
by that, we knowers of the sacred word, / purify the purified sacred word, svāhā!"
Taking another four ladlings, he offers in the āhavanīya fire itself: "May Indra purify me along with good guidance; / may Soma [purify me] with well-being, Varuṇa with harmony;

28.1.343.s: yamo rājā pramṛṇābhiḥ punātu māṃ jātavedā morjayantyā punātu svāhā | iti |
28.1.343.d: यमो राजा प्रमृणाभिः पुनातु मां जातवेदा मोर्जयन्त्या पुनातु स्वाहा । इति ।
28.1.343.m: may King Yama purify me with crushing blows; / may Jātavedas purify me with invigorating [strength], svāhā!"

28.1.343.s: atha pṛṣṭhyām̐ stīrtvāpaḥ praṇīya | agnaye 'm̐homuce 'ṣṭākapālas | iti daśahaviṣam iṣṭiṃ nirvapati śrapayitvāsādayati
28.1.343.d: अथ पृष्ठ्याँ स्तीर्त्वापः प्रणीय । अग्नये ऽँहोमुचे ऽष्टाकपालस् । इति दशहविषम् इष्टिं निर्वपति श्रपयित्वासादयति
28.1.343.m: Then, having spread out the darbha grass along the spinal line and carried forward the waters, he sets apart an offering of ten oblations [beginning with]: "A cake on eight potsherds for Agni who frees from distress"; having cooked them, he places them.

28.1.343.s: tasyāḥ saptadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ samidhyamānāṃ ca samiddhāṃ cāntareṇa pāvakavatyau dhāyye dadhāti | apām idaṃ nyayanam | namas te | iti dve
28.1.343.d: तस्याः सप्तदश सामिधेन्यः समिध्यमानां च समिद्धां चान्तरेण पावकवत्यौ धाय्ये दधाति । अपाम् इदं न्ययनम् । नमस् ते । इति द्वे
28.1.343.m:
Its kindling verses are seventeen.
Between the verse being kindled and the one kindled, he inserts two purifying additional verses: "This is the gathering-place of the waters" and "Homage to you"—these two.

28.1.343.s: pāvakavantāv evājyabhāgau | agnī rakṣām̐si sedhati śukraśocir amartyaḥ |
28.1.343.d: पावकवन्ताव् एवाज्यभागौ । अग्नी रक्षाँसि सेधति शुक्रशोचिर् अमर्त्यः ।
28.1.343.m:
The two butter-portions are indeed purifying.
Reciting the introductory verse: "Agni drives away the demons, / he of bright flame, immortal,

28.1.343.s: śuciḥ pāvaka īḍyas | iti puro'nuvākyām anūcya yat te pavitram arciṣi | agne vitatam antarā |
28.1.343.d: शुचिः पावक ईड्यस् । इति पुरोऽनुवाक्याम् अनूच्य यत् ते पवित्रम् अर्चिषि । अग्ने विततम् अन्तरा ।
28.1.343.m: pure, purifying, to be praised," / and [the offering verse]: "What purifier of yours is stretched / within your flame, O Agni,

28.1.344.m: with that we purify the sacred word," he offers the sacrifice.
Reciting the introductory verse: "He who with a purifying stream / flows around, pressed out,

28.1.344.s: indur aśvo na kṛtviyas | iti puro'nuvākyām anūcya | ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati pavitre pariṣicyate |
28.1.344.d: इन्दुर् अश्वो न कृत्वियस् । इति पुरोऽनुवाक्याम् अनूच्य । आ कलशेषु धावति पवित्रे परिषिच्यते ।
28.1.344.m: the drop like an active horse," / and [the offering verse]: "He runs into the jars, / he is poured out on the purifier,
he grows with recitations at the sacrifices," he offers the sacrifice.

28.1.344.s: atha haviṣām agner manve prathamasya pracetasas | ity etasminn anuvāke yājyāpuro'nuvākyāḥ sahasaṃyājyā bhavanti |
28.1.344.d: अथ हविषाम् अग्नेर् मन्वे प्रथमस्य प्रचेतसस् । इत्य् एतस्मिन्न् अनुवाके याज्यापुरोऽनुवाक्याः सहसंयाज्या भवन्ति ।
28.1.344.m: Then for the oblations, the introductory and offering verses in this section beginning "I think of Agni, the first, the mindful" are together with the after-offerings.

28.1.344.s: atha purastāt sviṣṭakṛtaḥ sruvāhutīr upajuhoti pavamānaḥ suvarjanas | ity etenānuvākena pratyṛcam |
28.1.344.d: अथ पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतः स्रुवाहुतीर् उपजुहोति पवमानः सुवर्जनस् । इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन प्रत्यृचम् ।
28.1.344.m: Then before the sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers ladle libations verse by verse with this section beginning: "Pavamāna, who wins the heavenly world."

The iḍā is well known.
Then, having placed the anvāhārya cooked rice, he gives gold [as dakṣiṇā].

28.1.344.s: samānaṃ karmā patnīsaṃyājebhyas | atha purastād gṛhapateḥ sruvāhutīr upajuhoti yad devā devaheḍanam ity etenānuvākena pratyṛcam |
28.1.344.d: समानं कर्मा पत्नीसंयाजेभ्यस् । अथ पुरस्ताद् गृहपतेः स्रुवाहुतीर् उपजुहोति यद् देवा देवहेडनम् इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन प्रत्यृचम् ।
28.1.344.m:
The procedure is the same up to the wife-offerings.
Then before the offering to Agni Gṛhapati, he offers ladle libations verse by verse with this section beginning: "Whatever wrath of the gods, O gods."

This sacrifice concludes with the full-cup offering and the steps of Viṣṇu.
He releases the vow.

28.1.344.s: etayaiva yajetartuvyatikrame dāravyatikrame 'yonau vā retaḥ siktvā |
28.1.344.d: एतयैव यजेतर्तुव्यतिक्रमे दारव्यतिक्रमे ऽयोनौ वा रेतः सिक्त्वा ।
28.1.344.m: One should sacrifice with this very sacrifice on the omission of a seasonal period, on the omission of ritual intercourse, or having spilled semen in an improper place.

28.1.344.s: etayaiva yajeta pātakopapātakasaṃyukto dvādaśāhaṃ mahāpātakasaṃyukto māsaṃ puṇyam icchan saṃvatsaram ṛtuṃ vā tām etāṃ mahāpavitreṣṭir ity ācakṣate mṛgāreṣṭir iti vā rahasyeṣṭir iti baudhāyanaḥ ||
28.1.344.d: एतयैव यजेत पातकोपपातकसंयुक्तो द्वादशाहं महापातकसंयुक्तो मासं पुण्यम् इच्छन् संवत्सरम् ऋतुं वा ताम् एतां महापवित्रेष्टिर् इत्य् आचक्षते मृगारेष्टिर् इति वा रहस्येष्टिर् इति बौधायनः ॥
28.1.344.m: One should sacrifice with this very sacrifice if joined with a minor sin for twelve days, if joined with a major sin for a month, or desiring merit for a year or a season; this they call the mahāpavitreṣṭi, or the mṛgāreṣṭi, or the secret sacrifice—so says Baudhāyana.

28.2.345.s: yatho etat so 'parimitaṃ pravasatīti na saṃvatsaram ati pravasatīty evedam uktaṃ bhavati sa u ced ati pravaset pavitreṣṭyā yajeteti |
28.2.345.d: यथो एतत् सो ऽपरिमितं प्रवसतीति न संवत्सरम् अति प्रवसतीत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति स उ चेद् अति प्रवसेत् पवित्रेष्ट्या यजेतेति ।
28.2.345.m: As for what is said: "He dwells away indefinitely," this is meant: "He does not dwell away beyond a year"; and if he should dwell away beyond it, he should sacrifice with the pavitreṣṭi.

28.2.345.s: etayeṣṭyā yakṣyamāṇa upakalpayate hiraṇyam | tasyāḥ prajñāta upavastathas |
28.2.345.d: एतयेष्ट्या यक्ष्यमाण उपकल्पयते हिरण्यम् । तस्याः प्रज्ञात उपवस्तथस् ।
28.2.345.m:
Intending to sacrifice with this sacrifice, he prepares gold.
Its fast-day is well known.

28.2.345.s: atha prātarhute 'gnihotre purāpāṃ praṇayanād gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye juhoty anvārabdhe yajamāne yena devāḥ pavitreṇa | ātmānaṃ punate sadā |
28.2.345.d: अथ प्रातर्हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे पुरापां प्रणयनाद् गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये जुहोत्य् अन्वारब्धे यजमाने येन देवाः पवित्रेण । आत्मानं पुनते सदा ।
28.2.345.m: Then, when the morning agnihotra has been offered and before carrying forward the waters, having melted clarified butter on the gārhapatya fire and purified it, taking four ladlings in the ladle, he offers in the āhavanīya fire while the sacrificer holds onto him: "With what purifier the gods / purify themselves always,

28.2.345.s: tena sahasradhāreṇa pāvamānyaḥ punantu mā svāhā | iti | aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīya eva juhoti prājāpatyaṃ pavitraṃ pavitram śatodyāmam̐ hiraṇmayam |
28.2.345.d: तेन सहस्रधारेण पावमान्यः पुनन्तु मा स्वाहा । इति । अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीय एव जुहोति प्राजापत्यं पवित्रं पवित्रम् शतोद्यामँ हिरण्मयम् ।
28.2.345.m:
with that thousand-streamed one, / may the purifying verses purify me, svāhā!"
Taking another four ladlings, he offers in the āhavanīya fire itself: "The purifier belonging to Prajāpati, / stretching out a hundredfold, made of gold,

28.2.345.s: tena brahmavido vayam | pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe svāhā | iti |
28.2.345.d: तेन ब्रह्मविदो वयम् । पूतं ब्रह्म पुनीमहे स्वाहा । इति ।
28.2.345.m: by that, we knowers of the sacred word, / purify the purified sacred word, svāhā!"

28.2.345.s: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīya eva juhoti | indraḥ sunītī saha mā punātu somaḥ svastyā varuṇaḥ samīcyā |
28.2.345.d: अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीय एव जुहोति । इन्द्रः सुनीती सह मा पुनातु सोमः स्वस्त्या वरुणः समीच्या ।
28.2.345.m: Taking another four ladlings, he offers in the āhavanīya fire itself: "May Indra purify me along with good guidance; / may Soma [purify me] with well-being, Varuṇa with harmony;

28.2.345.s: yamo rājā prasṛṇābhiḥ punātu māṃ jātavedā morjayantyā punātu svāhā | iti |
28.2.345.d: यमो राजा प्रसृणाभिः पुनातु मां जातवेदा मोर्जयन्त्या पुनातु स्वाहा । इति ।
28.2.345.m: may King Yama purify me with crushing blows; / may Jātavedas purify me with invigorating [strength], svāhā!"

28.2.345.s: atha pṛṣṭhyām̐ stīrtvāpaḥ praṇīyāgnaye pavamānāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati sarasvatyai priyāyā upām̐śv ājyam agnaye pāvakāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati sarasvatyai priyāyā upām̐śv ājyam agnaye pāvakāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati savitre satyaprasavāyopām̐śv ājyam agnaye śucaye puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati vāyave niyutvata upām̐śv ājyam agnaye vratapataye puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāyopām̐śv ājyam agnaye vaiśvānarāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati dadhikrāvṇa upām̐śv ājyam iti
28.2.345.d: अथ पृष्ठ्याँ स्तीर्त्वापः प्रणीयाग्नये पवमानाय पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति सरस्वत्यै प्रियाया उपाँश्व् आज्यम् अग्नये पावकाय पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति सरस्वत्यै प्रियाया उपाँश्व् आज्यम् अग्नये पावकाय पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति सवित्रे सत्यप्रसवायोपाँश्व् आज्यम् अग्नये शुचये पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति वायवे नियुत्वत उपाँश्व् आज्यम् अग्नये व्रतपतये पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति विष्णवे शिपिविष्टायोपाँश्व् आज्यम् अग्नये वैश्वानराय पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति दधिक्राव्ण उपाँश्व् आज्यम् इति
28.2.345.m: Then, having spread out the darbha grass along the spinal line and carried forward the waters, he sets apart a cake on eight potsherds for Agni Pavamāna, clarified butter silently for Sarasvatī the beloved, a cake on eight potsherds for Agni Pāvaka, clarified butter silently for Savitar of true instigation, a cake on eight potsherds for Agni Śuci, clarified butter silently for Vāyu with his teams, a cake on eight potsherds for Agni lord of vows, clarified butter silently for Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa, a cake on eight potsherds for Agni Vaiśvānara, and clarified butter silently for Dadhikrāvan.

28.2.346.m:
Having cooked them, he places them.
Its kindling verses are seventeen.

28.2.346.s: samidhyamānāṃ ca samiddhāṃ cāntareṇa pāvakavatyau dhāyye dadhāti | apām idaṃ nyayanam | namas te | iti dve
28.2.346.d: समिध्यमानां च समिद्धां चान्तरेण पावकवत्यौ धाय्ये दधाति । अपाम् इदं न्ययनम् । नमस् ते । इति द्वे
28.2.346.m: Between the verse being kindled and the one kindled, he inserts two purifying additional verses: "This is the gathering-place of the waters" and "Homage to you"—these two.
The two butter-portions are indeed purifying.

28.2.346.s: agnī rakṣām̐si sedhati śukraśocir amartyaḥ | śuciḥ pāvaka īḍyas | iti puro'nuvākyām anūcya yat te pavitram arciṣi | agne vitatam antarā |
28.2.346.d: अग्नी रक्षाँसि सेधति शुक्रशोचिर् अमर्त्यः । शुचिः पावक ईड्यस् । इति पुरोऽनुवाक्याम् अनूच्य यत् ते पवित्रम् अर्चिषि । अग्ने विततम् अन्तरा ।
28.2.346.m: Reciting the introductory verse: "Agni drives away the demons, / he of bright flame, immortal, / pure, purifying, to be praised," and [the offering verse]: "What purifier of yours is in the flame, / stretched within, O Agni,"

28.2.346.s: brahma tena punīmahe | iti yajati yo dhārayā pāvakayā pariprasyandate sutaḥ |
28.2.346.d: ब्रह्म तेन पुनीमहे । इति यजति यो धारया पावकया परिप्रस्यन्दते सुतः ।
28.2.346.m:
he offers the sacrifice with: "with that we purify the sacred word."
Reciting the introductory verse: "He who with a purifying stream / flows around, pressed out,

28.2.346.s: indur aśvo na kṛtviyas | iti puro'nuvākyāmanūcya | ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati pavitre pariṣicyate |
28.2.346.d: इन्दुर् अश्वो न कृत्वियस् । इति पुरोऽनुवाक्यामनूच्य । आ कलशेषु धावति पवित्रे परिषिच्यते ।
28.2.346.m: the drop like an active horse," / and [the offering verse]: "He runs into the jars, / he is poured out on the purifier,
he grows with recitations at the sacrifices," he offers the sacrifice.

28.2.346.s: atha haviṣām agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase | agne pavasva | ity agneḥ pavamānasya | uta naḥ priyā priyāsu | imā juhvānā yuṣmat | iti sarasvatyāḥ priyāyā agne pāvaka sa naḥ pāvaka | iti pāvakasya | ā viśvadevam ā satyena | iti savituḥ satyaprasavasya | agniḥ śucivratatamas | ud agne śucayas tava | iti śuces | vāyur agregā vāyo śukro ayāmi te | iti vāyor niyutvatas tvam agne vratapā asi yad vo vayaṃ pramināma vratāni | iti vratapateḥ pra tat te adya kim it te viṣṇo paricakṣyaṃ bhūt | iti viṣṇoḥ śipiviṣṭasya vaiśvānaro na ūtyā pṛṣṭo divi | iti vaiśvānarasya dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam ā dadhikrās | iti dadhikrāvṇas |
28.2.346.d: अथ हविषाम् अग्न आयूँषि पवसे । अग्ने पवस्व । इत्य् अग्नेः पवमानस्य । उत नः प्रिया प्रियासु । इमा जुह्वाना युष्मत् । इति सरस्वत्याः प्रियाया अग्ने पावक स नः पावक । इति पावकस्य । आ विश्वदेवम् आ सत्येन । इति सवितुः सत्यप्रसवस्य । अग्निः शुचिव्रततमस् । उद् अग्ने शुचयस् तव । इति शुचेस् । वायुर् अग्रेगा वायो शुक्रो अयामि ते । इति वायोर् नियुत्वतस् त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा असि यद् वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि । इति व्रतपतेः प्र तत् ते अद्य किम् इत् ते विष्णो परिचक्ष्यं भूत् । इति विष्णोः शिपिविष्टस्य वैश्वानरो न ऊत्या पृष्टो दिवि । इति वैश्वानरस्य दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषम् आ दधिक्रास् । इति दधिक्राव्णस् ।
28.2.346.m: Now, for the oblations: "Agni, you purify life-spans" [and] "O Agni, purify yourself" are [the introductory and offering verses] for Agni Pavamāna. "And she, our dear one among the dear ones" [and] "These oblations from you" are for dear Sarasvatī. "O purifying Agni" [and] "Purifying, may he to us" are for [Agni] Pāvaka. "To all the gods" [and] "With the truth" are for Savitar of true impulse. "Agni, whose vows are purest" [and] "Arise, Agni, pure are your [flames]" are for [Agni] Śuci. "Vāyu, foremost goer" [and] "O Vāyu, the bright [soma] is offered to you" are for Vāyu Niyutvat. "You, O Agni, are guardian of vows" [and] "If we violate your vows" are for [Agni] Vratapati. "Now proclaim that of yours" [and] "What of yours, O Viṣṇu, became blameworthy?" are for Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa. "Vaiśvānara to our help" [and] "Set upon the back in heaven" are for Vaiśvānara. "I have praised Dadhikrāvan" [and] "Dadhikrās has advanced" are for Dadhikrāvan.

28.2.346.s: atha hutānumantraṇam agneḥ pavamānasyāhaṃ devayajyayā śuciḥ pūto medhyo vipāpmā brahmavarcasy annādo bhūyāsam agneḥ pāvakasyāgneḥ śucer agner vratapater agner vaiśvānarasyāhaṃ devayajyayā śuciḥ pūto medhyo vipāpmā brahmavarcasy annādo bhūyāsam iti |
28.2.346.d: अथ हुतानुमन्त्रणम् अग्नेः पवमानस्याहं देवयज्यया शुचिः पूतो मेध्यो विपाप्मा ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् अन्नादो भूयासम् अग्नेः पावकस्याग्नेः शुचेर् अग्नेर् व्रतपतेर् अग्नेर् वैश्वानरस्याहं देवयज्यया शुचिः पूतो मेध्यो विपाप्मा ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् अन्नादो भूयासम् इति ।
28.2.346.m: Now the contemplation of the offered [oblations]: "Through the divine worship of Agni Pavamāna may I become pure, cleansed, sacrosanct, free from sin, full of sacred splendour, and an eater of food. Through the divine worship of Agni Pāvaka, Agni Śuci, Agni Vratapati, and Agni Vaiśvānara may I become pure, cleansed, sacrosanct, free from sin, full of sacred splendour, and an eater of food."

28.2.347.m: In the whisper-offering, it is just like the whisper-offering.

28.2.347.s: atha purastāt sviṣṭakṛtaḥ sruvāhutīr upajuhoti pavamānaḥ suvarjanas | ity etenānuvākena pratyṛcam
28.2.347.d: अथ पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतः स्रुवाहुतीर् उपजुहोति पवमानः सुवर्जनस् । इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन प्रत्यृचम्
28.2.347.m: Then, before the Sviṣṭakṛt, he offers ladle libations verse by verse with the section beginning: "Pavamāna, who wins heaven..."

28.2.347.s: atithivatyau damūnavatyau saṃyājye juṣṭo damūnā atithir duroṇe | imaṃ no yajñamupayāhi vidvān |
28.2.347.d: अतिथिवत्यौ दमूनवत्यौ संयाज्ये जुष्टो दमूना अतिथिर् दुरोणे । इमं नो यज्ञमुपयाहि विद्वान् ।
28.2.347.m: The two Saṃyājyā verses contain the words "guest" (atithi) and "house-mate" (damūnas): / "A welcome house-mate, a guest in the dwelling, / come knowing to this our sacrifice!"

28.2.347.s: viśvā agne abhiyujo vihatya śatrūyatām ābharā bhojanāni ||
28.2.347.d: विश्वा अग्ने अभियुजो विहत्य शत्रूयताम् आभरा भोजनानि ॥
28.2.347.m: "Having struck down all assailants, O Agni, / bring here the nourishments of those behaving as enemies!"

28.2.347.s: mārjālyo mṛjyate sve damūnāḥ kavipraśasto atithiḥ śivo naḥ |
28.2.347.d: मार्जाल्यो मृज्यते स्वे दमूनाः कविप्रशस्तो अतिथिः शिवो नः ।
28.2.347.m: "The house-mate is cleansed in his own place like the mārjālīya; / praised by sages, the guest is auspicious to us."

28.2.347.s: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabhas tadojās | viśvām̐ agne sahasā prāsy anyān iti
28.2.347.d: सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभस् तदोजास् । विश्वाँ अग्ने सहसा प्रास्य् अन्यान् इति
28.2.347.m: "The thousand-horned bull, of that power: / do you, O Agni, violently cast down all other [foes]!"
The iḍā is as prescribed. / Then, having set down the anvāhārya cooked rice, he gives gold [as the priestly fee].

28.2.347.s: samānaṃ karmā patnīsaṃyājebhyas | atha purastād gṛhapateḥ sruvāhutīr upajuhoti yad devā devaheḍanam ity etenānuvākena pratyṛcam |
28.2.347.d: समानं कर्मा पत्नीसंयाजेभ्यस् । अथ पुरस्ताद् गृहपतेः स्रुवाहुतीर् उपजुहोति यद् देवा देवहेडनम् इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन प्रत्यृचम् ।
28.2.347.m: The rite is the same up to the patnīsaṃyājas. / Then, before the [offering to Agni] Gṛhapati, he offers ladle libations verse by verse with the section beginning: "Whatever god-provocation, O gods...".
This iṣṭi concludes with the full-cup libation and the Viṣṇu-steps; he releases the vow.

28.2.347.s: etayaiva yajetābhiśasto 'bhiśasyamāno vā | etayaiva yajetartuvyatikrame dāravyatikrame 'yonau vā retaḥ siktvā |
28.2.347.d: एतयैव यजेताभिशस्तो ऽभिशस्यमानो वा । एतयैव यजेतर्तुव्यतिक्रमे दारव्यतिक्रमे ऽयोनौ वा रेतः सिक्त्वा ।
28.2.347.m: He should sacrifice with this very [iṣṭi] when accused or being accused. / He should sacrifice with this very [iṣṭi] upon omission of the proper season, upon transgression against the wife, or having emitted semen into an improper womb.
